### USER
Bantu saya bina satu aplikasi web (web app) pembelajaran dalam satu fail HTML sahaja bertajuk Poket Nota Sejarah SMKAMi untuk pelajar Tingkatan 1, 2 dan 3. Aplikasi mengandungi 20 tajuk nota mengikut silibus KSSM. Apabila kad tajuk diklik, paparkan emoji, tajuk, nota ringkas, 3 fakta penting dan gunakan Web Speech API untuk membaca nota dalam Bahasa Melayu. Semua HTML, CSS dan JavaScript mesti berada dalam satu fail HTML tanpa fail luaran. Reka bentuk hendaklah ceria, responsif, bertemakan Melayu Moden dengan elemen batik atau songket. Sediakan menu Utama, Nota, Kuiz dan Tentang, kotak carian, penapis mengikut tingkatan, mod terang/gelap, butang Main Sebutan, Henti Sebutan, Seterusnya, serta kuiz 10 soalan aneka pilihan dengan pemarkahan automatik. Pastikan aplikasi boleh digunakan secara luar talian, mudah diubah suai, mesra telefon dan komputer serta jumlah keseluruhan kandungan nota tidak melebihi 200 patah perkataan.

// STATE
let currentFilter = 'all';
let currentNoteIndex = 0;
let currentQuiz = 0;
let quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
let quizSubmitted = false;

// NAVIGATION
function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
}

// THEME
function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') {
    body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    btn.textContent = '🌙';
  } else {
    body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    btn.textContent = '☀️';
  }
}

// RENDER CARDS
function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  
  notaData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal(idx);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div>
      <div class="card-title">${item.title}</div>
      <span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() {
  renderCards();
}

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

// MODAL
function openModal(idx) {
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = notaData[idx];
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = 'Tingkatan ' + item.form;
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => {
    factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i+1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  stopSpeech();
}

function closeModalOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal();
}

function nextNote() {
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= notaData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(next);
}

// WEB SPEECH API
function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = notaData[currentNoteIndex];
  const text = `${item.title}. ${item.note}. Fakta pertama: ${item.facts[0]}. Fakta kedua: ${item.facts[1]}. Fakta ketiga: ${item.facts[2]}.`;
  
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  
  // Try to find Malay voice
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  
  utterance.onstart = () => {
    document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  };
  utterance.onend = () => {
    document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  };
  
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

// Load voices
if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
  speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices();
}

// QUIZ
function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0;
  quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
  quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('quizSubmitBtn').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('quizRestartBtn').style.display = 'none';
  renderQuiz();
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / quizData.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${quizData.length}`;
  
  let html = '';
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : '';
      html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65+j)}. ${opt}</button>`;
    });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  
  // Navigation buttons
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  }
  if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya ➡</button>`;
  } else {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  }
  
  // Update nav area
  const navArea = document.querySelector('.quiz-nav');
  navArea.innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) {
  if (quizSubmitted) return;
  quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx;
  renderQuiz();
}

function prevQuestion() {
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    currentQuiz--;
    renderQuiz();
  }
}

function nextQuestion() {
  if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) {
    currentQuiz++;
    renderQuiz();
  }
}

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0) {
    if (!confirm(`Anda masih belum menjawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar sekarang?`)) return;
  }
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  let score = 0;
  
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    const options = questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) score++;
  });
  
  document.querySelector('.quiz-nav').innerHTML = '';
  
  // Show result
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/10`;
    
    let msg = '';
    if (score === 10) msg = '🌟 Cemerlang! Anda menguasai Sejarah dengan baik!';
    else if (score >= 7) msg = '👏 Tahniah! Prestasi yang sangat baik!';
    else if (score >= 5) msg = '👍 Bagus! Teruskan usaha anda!';
    else msg = '💪 Jangan putus asa! Ulang kaji dan cuba lagi!';
    
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
  }, 1000);
}

// INIT
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderCards();
  // Preload voices
  speechSynthesis.getVoices();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

      <button class="speech-btn btn-play" onclick="playSpeech()">🔊 Main Sebutan</button>
      <button class="speech-btn btn-stop" onclick="stopSpeech()">⏹ Henti Sebutan</button>
      <button class="speech-btn btn-next" onclick="nextNote()">⏭ Seterusnya</button>
    </div>
    <div class="speaking-indicator" id="speakingIndicator">🔊 Sedang membaca...</div>
  </div>
</div>

// STATE
let currentFilter = 'all';
let currentNoteIndex = 0;
let currentQuiz = 0;
let quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
let quizSubmitted = false;

// VIDEO STATE
const VIDEO_DURATION = 120; // 2 minit = 120 saat
const SLIDE_DURATION = 20; // 6 slaid × 20 saat = 120 saat
let videoTimer = null;
let videoCurrentTime = 0;
let videoPlaying = false;
let videoMuted = false;
let currentSlideIndex = 0;
let currentSlides = [];

// NAVIGATION
function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') {
    body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    btn.textContent = '🌙';
  } else {
    body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    btn.textContent = '☀️';
  }
}

// RENDER CARDS
function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  notaData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal(idx);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div>
      <div class="card-title">${item.title}</div>
      <span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

// GENERATE VIDEO SLIDES (6 slaid × 20 saat)
function generateSlides(item) {
  return [
    {
      emoji: item.emoji,
      title: item.title,
      text: `Selamat datang ke video pembelajaran. Mari kita pelajari tentang ${item.title}.`,
      bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #8B1A1A 0%, #C0392B 100%)'
    },
    {
      emoji: '📖',
      title: 'Nota Ringkas',
      text: item.note,
      bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #0f3460 0%, #16213E 100%)'
    },
    {
      emoji: '⭐',
      title: 'Fakta 1',
      text: item.facts[0],
      bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #D4A017 0%, #8B1A1A 100%)'
    },
    {
      emoji: '💡',
      title: 'Fakta 2',
      text: item.facts[1],
      bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #16213E 0%, #0f3460 100%)'
    },
    {
      emoji: '🎯',
      title: 'Fakta 3',
      text: item.facts[2],
      bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #C0392B 0%, #D4A017 100%)'
    },
    {
      emoji: '🏆',
      title: 'Tahniah!',
      text: `Anda telah selesai mempelajari ${item.title}. Teruskan mengulang kaji!`,
      bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #8B1A1A 0%, #D4A017 100%)'
    }
  ];
}

// VIDEO PLAYER FUNCTIONS
function buildVideoSlides() {
  const screen = document.getElementById('videoScreen');
  screen.innerHTML = '';
  currentSlides.forEach((slide, i) => {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'slide' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
    div.id = 'slide-' + i;
    div.style.background = slide.bg;
    div.innerHTML = `
      <div class="slide-num">Slaid ${i+1}/6</div>
      <div class="slide-emoji">${slide.emoji}</div>
      <div class="slide-title">${slide.title}</div>
      <div class="slide-text">${slide.text}</div>
    `;
    screen.appendChild(div);
  });
}

function showSlide(index) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.slide').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  const slide = document.getElementById('slide-' + index);
  if (slide) slide.classList.add('active');
  currentSlideIndex = index;
  
  // Speak current slide
  if (!videoMuted) {
    speakSlide(currentSlides[index].text);
  }
}

function speakSlide(text) {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function startVideoTimer() {
  stopVideoTimer();
  videoTimer = setInterval(() => {
    videoCurrentTime++;
    updateVideoUI();
    
    // Change slide every SLIDE_DURATION seconds
    if (videoCurrentTime > 0 && videoCurrentTime % SLIDE_DURATION === 0) {
      const newSlide = Math.floor(videoCurrentTime / SLIDE_DURATION);
      if (newSlide < currentSlides.length) {
        showSlide(newSlide);
      }
    }
    
    if (videoCurrentTime >= VIDEO_DURATION) {
      pauseVideo();
      videoCurrentTime = VIDEO_DURATION;
      updateVideoUI();
    }
  }, 1000);
}

function stopVideoTimer() {
  if (videoTimer) {
    clearInterval(videoTimer);
    videoTimer = null;
  }
}

function updateVideoUI() {
  const progress = (videoCurrentTime / VIDEO_DURATION) * 100;
  document.getElementById('videoProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  
  const currentMin = Math.floor(videoCurrentTime / 60);
  const currentSec = videoCurrentTime % 60;
  document.getElementById('videoTime').textContent = 
    `${currentMin}:${String(currentSec).padStart(2, '0')} / 2:00`;
}

function toggleVideoPlay() {
  if (videoPlaying) {
    pauseVideo();
  } else {
    playVideo();
  }
}

function playVideo() {
  if (videoCurrentTime >= VIDEO_DURATION) {
    videoCurrentTime = 0;
    showSlide(0);
  }
  videoPlaying = true;
  document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').textContent = '⏸️';
  startVideoTimer();
  
  // Speak current slide if not already speaking
  if (!videoMuted) {
    speakSlide(currentSlides[currentSlideIndex].text);
  }
}

function pauseVideo() {
  videoPlaying = false;
  document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').textContent = '▶️';
  stopVideoTimer();
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
}

function restartVideo() {
  pauseVideo();
  videoCurrentTime = 0;
  currentSlideIndex = 0;
  showSlide(0);
  updateVideoUI();
}

function seekVideo(event) {
  const bar = event.currentTarget;
  const rect = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
  const clickX = event.clientX - rect.left;
  const percentage = clickX / rect.width;
  videoCurrentTime = Math.floor(percentage * VIDEO_DURATION);
  
  const newSlide = Math.min(Math.floor(videoCurrentTime / SLIDE_DURATION), currentSlides.length - 1);
  showSlide(newSlide);
  updateVideoUI();
  
  if (videoPlaying) {
    speechSynthesis.cancel();
    if (!videoMuted) speakSlide(currentSlides[newSlide].text);
  }
}

function toggleMute() {
  videoMuted = !videoMuted;
  document.getElementById('muteBtn').textContent = videoMuted ? '🔇' : '🔊';
  if (videoMuted) {
    speechSynthesis.cancel();
  } else if (videoPlaying) {
    speakSlide(currentSlides[currentSlideIndex].text);
  }
}

// MODAL
function openModal(idx) {
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = notaData[idx];
  
  // Reset video
  pauseVideo();
  videoCurrentTime = 0;
  currentSlideIndex = 0;
  currentSlides = generateSlides(item);
  buildVideoSlides();
  updateVideoUI();
  
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = 'Tingkatan ' + item.form;
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => {
    factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i+1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  pauseVideo();
  stopSpeech();
}

function closeModalOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal();
}

function nextNote() {
  pauseVideo();
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= notaData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(next);
}

// WEB SPEECH API (manual)
function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = notaData[currentNoteIndex];
  const text = `${item.title}. ${item.note}. Fakta pertama: ${item.facts[0]}. Fakta kedua: ${item.facts[1]}. Fakta ketiga: ${item.facts[2]}.`;
  
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
  speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices();
}

// QUIZ
function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0;
  quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
  quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  renderQuiz();
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / quizData.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${quizData.length}`;
  
  let html = '';
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : '';
      html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65+j)}. ${opt}</button>`;
    });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  }
  if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya ➡</button>`;
  } else {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) {
  if (quizSubmitted) return;
  quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx;
  renderQuiz();
}

function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } }

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0) {
    if (!confirm(`Anda masih belum menjawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar sekarang?`)) return;
  }
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  let score = 0;
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    const options = questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) score++;
  });
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/10`;
    let msg = '';
    if (score === 10) msg = '🌟 Cemerlang! Anda menguasai Sejarah dengan baik!';
    else if (score >= 7) msg = '👏 Tahniah! Prestasi yang sangat baik!';
    else if (score >= 5) msg = '👍 Bagus! Teruskan usaha anda!';
    else msg = '💪 Jangan putus asa! Ulang kaji dan cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
  }, 1000);
}

// INIT
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderCards();
  speechSynthesis.getVoices();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') {
    body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    btn.textContent = '🌙';
  } else {
    body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    btn.textContent = '☀️';
  }
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  notaData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal(idx);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div>
      <div class="card-title">${item.title}</div>
      <span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

function generateSlides(item) {
  return [
    { emoji: item.emoji, title: item.title, text: `Selamat datang ke video pembelajaran. Mari kita pelajari tentang ${item.title}.`, bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #8B1A1A 0%, #C0392B 100%)' },
    { emoji: '📖', title: 'Nota Ringkas', text: item.note, bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #0f3460 0%, #16213E 100%)' },
    { emoji: '📝', title: 'Butiran Lanjut', text: item.detail, bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #D4A017 0%, #8B1A1A 100%)' },
    { emoji: '⭐', title: 'Fakta 1', text: item.facts[0], bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #16213E 0%, #0f3460 100%)' },
    { emoji: '💡', title: 'Fakta 2 & 3', text: `${item.facts[1]}. ${item.facts[2]}`, bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #C0392B 0%, #D4A017 100%)' },
    { emoji: '🏆', title: 'Tahniah!', text: `Anda telah selesai mempelajari ${item.title}. Teruskan mengulang kaji!`, bg: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #8B1A1A 0%, #D4A017 100%)' }
  ];
}

function buildVideoSlides() {
  const screen = document.getElementById('videoScreen');
  screen.innerHTML = '';
  currentSlides.forEach((slide, i) => {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'slide' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
    div.id = 'slide-' + i;
    div.style.background = slide.bg;
    div.innerHTML = `
      <div class="slide-num">Slaid ${i+1}/6</div>
      <div class="slide-emoji">${slide.emoji}</div>
      <div class="slide-title">${slide.title}</div>
      <div class="slide-text">${slide.text}</div>
    `;
    screen.appendChild(div);
  });
}

function showSlide(index) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.slide').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  const slide = document.getElementById('slide-' + index);
  if (slide) slide.classList.add('active');
  currentSlideIndex = index;
  if (!videoMuted) speakSlide(currentSlides[index].text);
}

function speakSlide(text) {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function startVideoTimer() {
  stopVideoTimer();
  videoTimer = setInterval(() => {
    videoCurrentTime++;
    updateVideoUI();
    if (videoCurrentTime > 0 && videoCurrentTime % SLIDE_DURATION === 0) {
      const newSlide = Math.floor(videoCurrentTime / SLIDE_DURATION);
      if (newSlide < currentSlides.length) showSlide(newSlide);
    }
    if (videoCurrentTime >= VIDEO_DURATION) {
      pauseVideo();
      videoCurrentTime = VIDEO_DURATION;
      updateVideoUI();
    }
  }, 1000);
}

function stopVideoTimer() {
  if (videoTimer) { clearInterval(videoTimer); videoTimer = null; }
}

function updateVideoUI() {
  const progress = (videoCurrentTime / VIDEO_DURATION) * 100;
  document.getElementById('videoProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  const currentMin = Math.floor(videoCurrentTime / 60);
  const currentSec = videoCurrentTime % 60;
  document.getElementById('videoTime').textContent = `${currentMin}:${String(currentSec).padStart(2, '0')} / 2:00`;
}

function toggleVideoPlay() {
  if (videoPlaying) pauseVideo(); else playVideo();
}

function playVideo() {
  if (videoCurrentTime >= VIDEO_DURATION) { videoCurrentTime = 0; showSlide(0); }
  videoPlaying = true;
  document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').textContent = '⏸️';
  startVideoTimer();
  if (!videoMuted) speakSlide(currentSlides[currentSlideIndex].text);
}

function pauseVideo() {
  videoPlaying = false;
  document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').textContent = '▶️';
  stopVideoTimer();
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
}

function restartVideo() {
  pauseVideo();
  videoCurrentTime = 0;
  currentSlideIndex = 0;
  showSlide(0);
  updateVideoUI();
}

function seekVideo(event) {
  const bar = event.currentTarget;
  const rect = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
  const clickX = event.clientX - rect.left;
  const percentage = clickX / rect.width;
  videoCurrentTime = Math.floor(percentage * VIDEO_DURATION);
  const newSlide = Math.min(Math.floor(videoCurrentTime / SLIDE_DURATION), currentSlides.length - 1);
  showSlide(newSlide);
  updateVideoUI();
  if (videoPlaying) { speechSynthesis.cancel(); if (!videoMuted) speakSlide(currentSlides[newSlide].text); }
}

function toggleMute() {
  videoMuted = !videoMuted;
  document.getElementById('muteBtn').textContent = videoMuted ? '🔇' : '🔊';
  if (videoMuted) speechSynthesis.cancel();
  else if (videoPlaying) speakSlide(currentSlides[currentSlideIndex].text);
}

function openModal(idx) {
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = notaData[idx];
  pauseVideo();
  videoCurrentTime = 0;
  currentSlideIndex = 0;
  currentSlides = generateSlides(item);
  buildVideoSlides();
  updateVideoUI();
  
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = 'Tingkatan ' + item.form;
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  document.getElementById('modalDetail').textContent = item.detail;
  
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => {
    factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i+1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  pauseVideo();
  stopSpeech();
}

function closeModalOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal();
}

function nextNote() {
  pauseVideo();
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= notaData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(next);
}

function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = notaData[currentNoteIndex];
  const text = `${item.title}. ${item.note}. ${item.detail}. Fakta pertama: ${item.facts[0]}. Fakta kedua: ${item.facts[1]}. Fakta ketiga: ${item.facts[2]}.`;
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
  speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices();
}

function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0;
  quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
  quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  renderQuiz();
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / quizData.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${quizData.length}`;
  
  let html = '';
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : '';
      html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65+j)}. ${opt}</button>`;
    });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  }
  if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya ➡</button>`;
  } else {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) {
  if (quizSubmitted) return;
  quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx;
  renderQuiz();
}

function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } }

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0) {
    if (!confirm(`Anda masih belum menjawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar sekarang?`)) return;
  }
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  let score = 0;
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    const options = questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) score++;
  });
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/10`;
    let msg = '';
    if (score === 10) msg = '🌟 Cemerlang! Anda menguasai Sejarah dengan baik!';
    else if (score >= 7) msg = '👏 Tahniah! Prestasi yang sangat baik!';
    else if (score >= 5) msg = '👍 Bagus! Teruskan usaha anda!';
    else msg = '💪 Jangan putus asa! Ulang kaji dan cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
  }, 1000);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderCards();
  speechSynthesis.getVoices();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

let currentFilter = 'all';
let currentNoteIndex = 0;
let currentQuiz = 0;
let quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
let quizSubmitted = false;

// VIDEO STATE
const VIDEO_DURATION = 120; // 2 minit
const SLIDE_DURATION = 20; // 6 slaid x 20 saat
let videoTimer = null;
let videoCurrentTime = 0;
let videoPlaying = false;
let videoMuted = false;
let currentSlideIndex = 0;
let currentSlides = [];

function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') {
    body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    btn.textContent = '🌙';
  } else {
    body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    btn.textContent = '☀️';
  }
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  notaData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal(idx);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div>
      <div class="card-title">${item.title}</div>
      <span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

// GENERATE CINEMATIC SLIDES
function generateSlides(item) {
  return [
    { 
      type: 'intro', emoji: item.emoji, title: item.title, 
      text: `Selamat datang ke video pembelajaran sinematik. Mari kita selami sejarah tentang ${item.title}.`, 
      bgClass: 'slide-intro' 
    },
    { 
      type: 'content', emoji: '📖', title: 'Nota Ringkas', 
      text: item.note, 
      bgClass: 'slide-content' 
    },
    { 
      type: 'content', emoji: '📝', title: 'Butiran Lanjut', 
      text: item.detail, 
      bgClass: 'slide-content' 
    },
    { 
      type: 'fact', emoji: '⭐', title: 'Fakta Utama 1', 
      text: item.facts[0], 
      bgClass: 'slide-fact' 
    },
    { 
      type: 'fact', emoji: '💡', title: 'Fakta Utama 2 & 3', 
      text: `${item.facts[1]}. ${item.facts[2]}`, 
      bgClass: 'slide-fact' 
    },
    { 
      type: 'end', emoji: '🏆', title: 'Tahniah!', 
      text: `Anda telah selesai mempelajari ${item.title}. Teruskan mengulang kaji untuk cemerlang!`, 
      bgClass: 'slide-end' 
    }
  ];
}

function buildVideoSlides() {
  const screen = document.getElementById('videoScreen');
  screen.innerHTML = '';
  currentSlides.forEach((slide, i) => {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = `slide ${slide.bgClass}` + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
    div.id = 'slide-' + i;
    div.innerHTML = `
      <div class="slide-num">Slaid ${i+1}/6</div>
      <div class="slide-emoji">${slide.emoji}</div>
      <div class="slide-title">${slide.title}</div>
      <div class="slide-text">${slide.text}</div>
    `;
    screen.appendChild(div);
  });
}

function showSlide(index) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.slide').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  const slide = document.getElementById('slide-' + index);
  if (slide) slide.classList.add('active');
  currentSlideIndex = index;
  if (!videoMuted) speakSlide(currentSlides[index].text);
}

function speakSlide(text) {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function startVideoTimer() {
  stopVideoTimer();
  videoTimer = setInterval(() => {
    videoCurrentTime++;
    updateVideoUI();
    if (videoCurrentTime > 0 && videoCurrentTime % SLIDE_DURATION === 0) {
      const newSlide = Math.floor(videoCurrentTime / SLIDE_DURATION);
      if (newSlide < currentSlides.length) showSlide(newSlide);
    }
    if (videoCurrentTime >= VIDEO_DURATION) {
      pauseVideo();
      videoCurrentTime = VIDEO_DURATION;
      updateVideoUI();
    }
  }, 1000);
}

function stopVideoTimer() {
  if (videoTimer) { clearInterval(videoTimer); videoTimer = null; }
}

function updateVideoUI() {
  const progress = (videoCurrentTime / VIDEO_DURATION) * 100;
  document.getElementById('videoProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  const currentMin = Math.floor(videoCurrentTime / 60);
  const currentSec = videoCurrentTime % 60;
  document.getElementById('videoTime').textContent = `${currentMin}:${String(currentSec).padStart(2, '0')} / 2:00`;
}

function toggleVideoPlay() {
  if (videoPlaying) pauseVideo(); else playVideo();
}

function playVideo() {
  if (videoCurrentTime >= VIDEO_DURATION) { videoCurrentTime = 0; showSlide(0); }
  videoPlaying = true;
  document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').textContent = '⏸️';
  startVideoTimer();
  if (!videoMuted) speakSlide(currentSlides[currentSlideIndex].text);
}

function pauseVideo() {
  videoPlaying = false;
  document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').textContent = '▶️';
  stopVideoTimer();
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
}

function restartVideo() {
  pauseVideo();
  videoCurrentTime = 0;
  currentSlideIndex = 0;
  showSlide(0);
  updateVideoUI();
}

function seekVideo(event) {
  const bar = event.currentTarget;
  const rect = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
  const clickX = event.clientX - rect.left;
  const percentage = clickX / rect.width;
  videoCurrentTime = Math.floor(percentage * VIDEO_DURATION);
  const newSlide = Math.min(Math.floor(videoCurrentTime / SLIDE_DURATION), currentSlides.length - 1);
  showSlide(newSlide);
  updateVideoUI();
  if (videoPlaying) { speechSynthesis.cancel(); if (!videoMuted) speakSlide(currentSlides[newSlide].text); }
}

function toggleMute() {
  videoMuted = !videoMuted;
  document.getElementById('muteBtn').textContent = videoMuted ? '🔇' : '';
  if (videoMuted) speechSynthesis.cancel();
  else if (videoPlaying) speakSlide(currentSlides[currentSlideIndex].text);
}

// MODAL FUNCTIONS
function openModal(idx) {
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = notaData[idx];
  pauseVideo();
  videoCurrentTime = 0;
  currentSlideIndex = 0;
  currentSlides = generateSlides(item);
  buildVideoSlides();
  updateVideoUI();
  
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = 'Tingkatan ' + item.form;
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  document.getElementById('modalDetail').textContent = item.detail;
  
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => {
    factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i+1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  pauseVideo();
  stopSpeech();
}

function closeModalOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal();
}

function nextNote() {
  pauseVideo();
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= notaData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(next);
}

// SPEECH API
function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = notaData[currentNoteIndex];
  const text = `${item.title}. ${item.note}. ${item.detail}. Fakta pertama: ${item.facts[0]}. Fakta kedua: ${item.facts[1]}. Fakta ketiga: ${item.facts[2]}.`;
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
  speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices();
}

// QUIZ FUNCTIONS
function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0;
  quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
  quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  renderQuiz();
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / quizData.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${quizData.length}`;
  
  let html = '';
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : '';
      html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65+j)}. ${opt}</button>`;
    });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:14px 30px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.5px;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  }
  if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:14px 30px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.5px;">Seterusnya ➡</button>`;
  } else {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:14px 30px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.5px;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) {
  if (quizSubmitted) return;
  quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx;
  renderQuiz();
}

function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } }

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0) {
    if (!confirm(`Anda masih belum menjawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar sekarang?`)) return;
  }
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  let score = 0;
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    const options = questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) score++;
  });
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/10`;
    let msg = '';
    if (score === 10) msg = '🌟 Cemerlang! Anda menguasai Sejarah dengan baik!';
    else if (score >= 7) msg = ' Tahniah! Prestasi yang sangat baik!';
    else if (score >= 5) msg = '👍 Bagus! Teruskan usaha anda!';
    else msg = '💪 Jangan putus asa! Ulang kaji dan cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
  }, 1000);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderCards();
  speechSynthesis.getVoices();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

    note: "Malaysia dibentuk pada 16 September 1963 dengan penyatuan Tanah Melayu, Sabah, Sarawak, dan Singapura. Gabungan ini bertujuan mengukuhkan keselamatan dan pembangunan ekonomi serantau.",
    detail: "Suruhanjaya Cobbald ditubuhkan untuk mengkaji pendapat rakyat Sabah dan Sarawak mengenai penyertaan dalam Malaysia. Kedua-dua negeri bersetuju menyertai Malaysia. Singapura keluar daripada Malaysia pada 9 Ogos 1965 kerana perbezaan politik. Hari Malaysia disambut pada 16 September setiap tahun untuk memperingati pembentukan negara.",
    facts: ["Sabah, Sarawak, dan Singapura menyertai Tanah Melayu untuk membentuk Malaysia pada 1963", "Singapura keluar daripada Malaysia pada 9 Ogos 1965 kerana perbezaan politik", "Hari Malaysia disambut pada 16 September setiap tahun sebagai peringatan pembentukan negara"]
  }
];

const quizData = [
  { q: "Siapakah pengasas Kesultanan Melaka?", options: ["Sultan Iskandar Shah", "Parameswara", "Tun Perak", "Hang Tuah"], answer: 1 },
  { q: "Bilakah Tanah Melayu mencapai kemerdekaan?", options: ["31 Ogos 1957", "16 September 1963", "1 Ogos 1957", "31 Ogos 1963"], answer: 0 },
  { q: "Apakah sistem pembesar utama Melaka?", options: ["Pembesar Dua", "Pembesar Empat", "Pembesar Lapan", "Pembesar Enam"], answer: 1 },
  { q: "Kuasa Barat manakah menakluki Melaka pada 1511?", options: ["Belanda", "British", "Portugis", "Sepanyol"], answer: 2 },
  { q: "Suruhanjaya yang menggubal Perlembagaan 1957 ialah?", options: ["Suruhanjaya Cobbald", "Suruhanjaya Reid", "Suruhanjaya Perlembagaan", "Suruhanjaya Diraja"], answer: 1 },
  { q: "Bilakah Malaysia dibentuk?", options: ["31 Ogos 1957", "16 September 1963", "9 Ogos 1965", "1 Januari 1963"], answer: 1 },
  { q: "Tapak prasejarah terkenal di Malaysia ialah?", options: ["Gua Tempurung", "Gua Niah dan Lenggong", "Bukit Bintang", "Gunung Kinabalu"], answer: 1 },
  { q: "Parti yang ditubuhkan untuk menentang Malayan Union?", options: ["MCA", "MIC", "UMNO", "PAS"], answer: 2 },
  { q: "Agama rasmi Kesultanan Melaka ialah?", options: ["Hindu", "Buddha", "Kristian", "Islam"], answer: 3 },
  { q: "Siapakah Bapa Kemerdekaan Tanah Melayu?", options: ["Tun Razak", "Tunku Abdul Rahman", "Tun Dr. Mahathir", "Hang Tuah"], answer: 1 }
];

let currentFilter = 'all';
let currentNoteIndex = 0;
let currentQuiz = 0;
let quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
let quizSubmitted = false;

function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') {
    body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    btn.textContent = '🌙';
  } else {
    body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    btn.textContent = '☀️';
  }
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  notaData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal(idx);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div>
      <div class="card-title">${item.title}</div>
      <span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

function openModal(idx) {
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = notaData[idx];
  
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = 'Tingkatan ' + item.form;
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  document.getElementById('modalDetail').textContent = item.detail;
  
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => {
    factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i+1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  stopSpeech();
}

function closeModalOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal();
}

function nextNote() {
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= notaData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(next);
}

function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = notaData[currentNoteIndex];
  const text = `${item.title}. ${item.note}. ${item.detail}. Fakta pertama: ${item.facts[0]}. Fakta kedua: ${item.facts[1]}. Fakta ketiga: ${item.facts[2]}.`;
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
  speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices();
}

function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0;
  quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
  quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  renderQuiz();
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / quizData.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${quizData.length}`;
  
  let html = '';
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : '';
      html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65+j)}. ${opt}</button>`;
    });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  }
  if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya ➡</button>`;
  } else {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) {
  if (quizSubmitted) return;
  quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx;
  renderQuiz();
}

function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } }

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0) {
    if (!confirm(`Anda masih belum menjawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar sekarang?`)) return;
  }
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  let score = 0;
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    const options = questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) score++;
  });
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/10`;
    let msg = '';
    if (score === 10) msg = ' Cemerlang! Anda menguasai Sejarah dengan baik!';
    else if (score >= 7) msg = '👏 Tahniah! Prestasi yang sangat baik!';
    else if (score >= 5) msg = '👍 Bagus! Teruskan usaha anda!';
    else msg = '💪 Jangan putus asa! Ulang kaji dan cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
  }, 1000);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderCards();
  speechSynthesis.getVoices();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

### USER
tambah ai tuto untuk membantu pelajar bertanya soalan atau ingin mengetahui lebih daripada apa yang diajari

### ASSISTANT
Berikut adalah kod HTML lengkap yang telah dikemas kini. Saya telah menambah butang **AI Tutor** terapung dan tetingkap sembang (chat window) yang membolehkan pelajar berinteraksi, bertanya soalan, atau mendapatkan penjelasan lanjut mengenai nota sejarah tersebut.

Sistem AI ini menggunakan logik "keyword matching" pintar untuk menjawab soalan berdasarkan data nota yang ada, serta memberikan jawapan umum jika soalan berada di luar skop nota.

let currentFilter = 'all';
let currentNoteIndex = 0;
let currentQuiz = 0;
let quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
let quizSubmitted = false;

function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') {
    body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    btn.textContent = '🌙';
  } else {
    body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    btn.textContent = '☀️';
  }
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  notaData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal(idx);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div>
      <div class="card-title">${item.title}</div>
      <span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

function openModal(idx) {
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = notaData[idx];
  
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = 'Tingkatan ' + item.form;
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  document.getElementById('modalDetail').textContent = item.detail;
  
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => {
    factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i+1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  stopSpeech();
}

function closeModalOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal();
}

function nextNote() {
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= notaData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(next);
}

function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = notaData[currentNoteIndex];
  const text = `${item.title}. ${item.note}. ${item.detail}. Fakta pertama: ${item.facts[0]}. Fakta kedua: ${item.facts[1]}. Fakta ketiga: ${item.facts[2]}.`;
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
  speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices();
}

// QUIZ FUNCTIONS
function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0;
  quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
  quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  renderQuiz();
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / quizData.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${quizData.length}`;
  
  let html = '';
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : '';
      html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65+j)}. ${opt}</button>`;
    });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  }
  if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya ➡</button>`;
  } else {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) {
  if (quizSubmitted) return;
  quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx;
  renderQuiz();
}

function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { if (currentQuiz < quizData.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } }

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0) {
    if (!confirm(`Anda masih belum menjawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar sekarang?`)) return;
  }
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  let score = 0;
  quizData.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    const options = questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) score++;
  });
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/10`;
    let msg = '';
    if (score === 10) msg = '🌟 Cemerlang! Anda menguasai Sejarah dengan baik!';
    else if (score >= 7) msg = '👏 Tahniah! Prestasi yang sangat baik!';
    else if (score >= 5) msg = '👍 Bagus! Teruskan usaha anda!';
    else msg = '💪 Jangan putus asa! Ulang kaji dan cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
  }, 1000);
}

// AI TUTOR FUNCTIONS
let isChatOpen = false;

function toggleChat() {
  isChatOpen = !isChatOpen;
  const chatWindow = document.getElementById('aiChatWindow');
  if (isChatOpen) {
    chatWindow.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('chatInput').focus();
  } else {
    chatWindow.classList.remove('active');
  }
}

function handleChatKey(event) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    sendChatMessage();
  }
}

function sendChatMessage() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
  const message = input.value.trim();
  if (!message) return;
  
  addChatMessage(message, 'user');
  input.value = '';
  
  // Show typing indicator
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'typing-indicator';
  typingDiv.id = 'typingIndicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div>';
  chatBody.appendChild(typingDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
  
  // Simulate AI thinking and respond
  setTimeout(() => {
    const typingEl = document.getElementById('typingIndicator');
    if (typingEl) typingEl.remove();
    
    const response = generateAIResponse(message);
    addChatMessage(response, 'bot');
  }, 1000 + Math.random() * 1000);
}

function addChatMessage(text, sender) {
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
  msgDiv.className = `chat-message msg-${sender}`;
  msgDiv.textContent = text;
  chatBody.appendChild(msgDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
}

function generateAIResponse(query) {
  const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
  
  // Check for greetings
  if (lowerQuery.includes('hai') || lowerQuery.includes('hello') || lowerQuery.includes('assalamualaikum')) {
    return "Waalaikumussalam! 👋 Selamat datang! Saya sedia membantu anda belajar Sejarah. Ada topik khusus yang anda ingin tahu?";
  }
  
  // Check for thanks
  if (lowerQuery.includes('terima kasih') || lowerQuery.includes('thanks')) {
    return "Sama-sama! 😊 Sentiasa berusaha untuk cemerlang dalam Sejarah ya!";
  }
  
  // Search through notes for relevant keywords
  let bestMatch = null;
  let highestScore = 0;
  
  notaData.forEach(item => {
    let score = 0;
    const titleLower = item.title.toLowerCase();
    const noteLower = item.note.toLowerCase();
    const detailLower = item.detail.toLowerCase();
    const factsLower = item.facts.join(' ').toLowerCase();
    const allText = `${titleLower} ${noteLower} ${detailLower} ${factsLower}`;
    
    // Check if query words appear in the content
    const queryWords = lowerQuery.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 2);
    queryWords.forEach(word => {
      if (allText.includes(word)) score += 2;
      if (titleLower.includes(word)) score += 5;
    });
    
    if (score > highestScore) {
      highestScore = score;
      bestMatch = item;
    }
  });
  
  // If found a good match
  if (bestMatch && highestScore >= 3) {
    const responses = [
      `📚 Berdasarkan nota saya, tentang **${bestMatch.title}**: ${bestMatch.note}\n\n Tambahan: ${bestMatch.detail.substring(0, 150)}...`,
      `🎯 Topik **${bestMatch.title}** (Tingkatan ${bestMatch.form}):\n${bestMatch.note}\n\nFakta penting: ${bestMatch.facts[0]}`,
      `✨ Mengenai **${bestMatch.title}**, berikut adalah ringkasan:\n${bestMatch.note}\n\nAdakah anda ingin tahu lebih lanjut tentang fakta-faktanya?`
    ];
    return responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)];
  }
  
  // Specific keyword checks for common questions
  if (lowerQuery.includes('parameswara') || lowerQuery.includes('pengasas melaka')) {
    return "🏰 Parameswara ialah pengasas Kesultanan Melayu Melaka pada tahun 1402. Beliau melarikan diri dari Palembang dan memilih lokasi strategik di Selat Melaka untuk membina empayar perdagangan yang hebat!";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('merdeka') || lowerQuery.includes('kemerdekaan')) {
    return " Tanah Melayu mencapai kemerdekaan pada 31 Ogos 1957! Tunku Abdul Rahman Putra Al-Haj melaungkan 'Merdeka' sebanyak 7 kali di Stadium Merdeka. Tarikh ini kini disambut sebagai Hari Kebangsaan setiap tahun.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('british') || lowerQuery.includes('penjajah')) {
    return "🇬🇧 British menjajah Tanah Melayu untuk mendapatkan sumber ekonomi seperti bijih timah dan getah. Mereka memperkenalkan Sistem Residen melalui Perjanjian Pangkor 1874 yang membolehkan mereka mengawal pentadbiran negeri-negeri Melayu.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('islam')) {
    return "☪️ Islam tiba di Asia Tenggara melalui pedagang Muslim dari Arab dan Gujarat. Proses penyebaran berlaku secara aman melalui perdagangan, perkahwinan, dan dakwah. Kesultanan Melaka menjadi pusat penyebaran Islam ke seluruh Alam Melayu.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('prasejarah') || lowerQuery.includes('zaman batu')) {
    return " Zaman Prasejarah terbahagi kepada Paleolitik, Mesolitik, Neolitik, dan Zaman Logam. Di Malaysia, tapak penting termasuk Gua Niah di Sarawak dan Lembah Lenggong di Perak. Manusia purba mula bercucuk tanam pada Zaman Neolitik.";
  }
  
  // Default response for unmatched queries
  const defaults = [
    "🤔 Soalan yang menarik! Saya tidak mempunyai maklumat spesifik tentang itu dalam nota saya, tetapi saya cadangkan anda rujuk buku teks Sejarah Tingkatan anda atau tanya guru. Ada topik lain yang boleh saya bantu?",
    " Hmm, saya tidak pasti tentang perkara itu. Cuba tanya tentang topik seperti Kesultanan Melaka, Kemerdekaan, atau Zaman Prasejarah. Saya lebih pakar dalam bidang tersebut!",
    "💡 Saya fokus pada nota Sejarah KSSM Tingkatan 1-3. Jika soalan anda berkaitan dengan topik tersebut, cuba gunakan kata kunci yang lebih spesifik. Saya sedia membantu!"
  ];
  
  return defaults[Math.floor(Math.random() * defaults.length)];
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderCards();
  speechSynthesis.getVoices();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

### USER
pastikan ai tersebut dapat digunakan

### ASSISTANT
Berikut adalah kod HTML lengkap yang telah dikemas kini. Saya telah menambah **AI Tutor Pintar** yang berfungsi sepenuhnya menggunakan logik pemadanan kata kunci (keyword matching) dan carian teks dalam data nota yang ada.

AI ini boleh:
1.  Menjawab soalan umum tentang sejarah Malaysia
2.  Mencari maklumat spesifik dari 20 tajuk nota KSSM
3.  Memberikan penjelasan lanjut apabila pelajar bertanya "lebih lanjut" atau "detail"
4.  Berfungsi tanpa internet (offline) kerana semua logik diproses di pelayar web

  { q: "Siapakah pengasas Kesultanan Melaka?", options: ["Sultan Iskandar Shah", "Parameswara", "Tun Perak", "Hang Tuah"], answer: 1 },
  { q: "Bilakah Tanah Melayu mencapai kemerdekaan?", options: ["31 Ogos 1957", "16 September 1963", "1 Ogos 1957", "31 Ogos 1963"], answer: 0 },
