let currentFilter = 'all';
let currentNoteIndex = 0;
let currentQuizForm = 1;
let currentQuiz = 0;
let quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
let quizSubmitted = false;

function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') {
    body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    btn.textContent = '🌙';
  } else {
    body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    btn.textContent = '☀️';
  }
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  notaData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    // Filter logic for Form 2 chapters
    let show = true;
    if (currentFilter === 1 && item.id > 5) show = false;
    if (currentFilter === 2 && item.id <= 5) show = false;
    
    if (!show) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal(idx);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div>
      <div class="card-title">${item.title}</div>
      <span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

function openModal(idx) {
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = notaData[idx];
  
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = 'Tingkatan ' + item.form;
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  document.getElementById('modalDetail').textContent = item.detail;
  
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => {
    factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i+1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  stopSpeech();
}

function closeModalOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal();
}

function nextNote() {
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= notaData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(next);
}

function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = notaData[currentNoteIndex];
  const text = `${item.title}. ${item.note}. ${item.detail}. Fakta pertama: ${item.facts[0]}. Fakta kedua: ${item.facts[1]}. Fakta ketiga: ${item.facts[2]}.`;
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
  speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices();
}

// MULTI-FORM QUIZ FUNCTIONS
function switchQuizTab(form, btn) {
  currentQuizForm = form;
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('quizTitle').textContent = `📝 Kuiz Sejarah Bab ${form === 1 ? '1-5' : '6-10'}`;
  restartQuiz();
}

function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0;
  quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
  quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  renderQuiz();
}

function getCurrentQuizData() {
  return quizDataByForm[currentQuizForm];
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / data.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${data.length}`;
  
  let html = '';
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : '';
      html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65+j)}. ${opt}</button>`;
    });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  }
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya </button>`;
  } else {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) {
  if (quizSubmitted) return;
  quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx;
  renderQuiz();
}

function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { 
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } 
}

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0) {
    if (!confirm(`Anda masih belum menjawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar sekarang?`)) return;
  }
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  let score = 0;
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    const options = questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) score++;
  });
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/${data.length}`;
    let msg = '';
    const percentage = (score / data.length) * 100;
    if (percentage === 100) msg = ' Cemerlang! Anda menguasai Sejarah Tingkatan 2 dengan baik!';
    else if (percentage >= 70) msg = '👏 Tahniah! Prestasi yang sangat baik!';
    else if (percentage >= 50) msg = ' Bagus! Teruskan usaha anda!';
    else msg = '💪 Jangan putus asa! Ulang kaji dan cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
  }, 1000);
}

// AI TUTOR FUNCTIONS
let isChatOpen = false;

function toggleChat() {
  isChatOpen = !isChatOpen;
  const chatWindow = document.getElementById('aiChatWindow');
  if (isChatOpen) {
    chatWindow.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('chatInput').focus();
  } else {
    chatWindow.classList.remove('active');
  }
}

function handleChatKey(event) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    sendChatMessage();
  }
}

function sendChatMessage() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
  const message = input.value.trim();
  if (!message) return;
  
  addChatMessage(message, 'user');
  input.value = '';
  
  // Show typing indicator
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'typing-indicator';
  typingDiv.id = 'typingIndicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div>';
  chatBody.appendChild(typingDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
  
  // Simulate AI thinking and respond
  setTimeout(() => {
    const typingEl = document.getElementById('typingIndicator');
    if (typingEl) typingEl.remove();
    
    const response = generateAIResponse(message);
    addChatMessage(response, 'bot');
  }, 1000 + Math.random() * 1000);
}

function addChatMessage(text, sender) {
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
  msgDiv.className = `chat-message msg-${sender}`;
  msgDiv.textContent = text;
  chatBody.appendChild(msgDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
}

function generateAIResponse(query) {
  const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
  
  // Check for greetings
  if (lowerQuery.includes('hai') || lowerQuery.includes('hello') || lowerQuery.includes('assalamualaikum')) {
    return "Waalaikumussalam! 👋 Selamat datang! Saya sedia membantu anda belajar Sejarah Tingkatan 2. Ada topik khusus yang anda ingin tahu?";
  }
  
  // Check for thanks
  if (lowerQuery.includes('terima kasih') || lowerQuery.includes('thanks')) {
    return "Sama-sama! 😊 Sentiasa berusaha untuk cemerlang dalam Sejarah ya!";
  }
  
  // Search through notes for relevant keywords
  let bestMatch = null;
  let highestScore = 0;
  
  notaData.forEach(item => {
    let score = 0;
    const titleLower = item.title.toLowerCase();
    const noteLower = item.note.toLowerCase();
    const detailLower = item.detail.toLowerCase();
    const factsLower = item.facts.join(' ').toLowerCase();
    const allText = `${titleLower} ${noteLower} ${detailLower} ${factsLower}`;
    
    // Check if query words appear in the content
    const queryWords = lowerQuery.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 2);
    queryWords.forEach(word => {
      if (allText.includes(word)) score += 2;
      if (titleLower.includes(word)) score += 5;
    });
    
    if (score > highestScore) {
      highestScore = score;
      bestMatch = item;
    }
  });
  
  // If found a good match
  if (bestMatch && highestScore >= 3) {
    const responses = [
      `📚 Berdasarkan nota saya, tentang **${bestMatch.title}**: ${bestMatch.note}\n\n Tambahan: ${bestMatch.detail.substring(0, 150)}...`,
      ` Topik **${bestMatch.title}**:\n${bestMatch.note}\n\nFakta penting: ${bestMatch.facts[0]}`,
      `✨ Mengenai **${bestMatch.title}**, berikut adalah ringkasan:\n${bestMatch.note}\n\nAdakah anda ingin tahu lebih lanjut tentang fakta-faktanya?`
    ];
    return responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)];
  }
  
  // Specific keyword checks for common questions
  if (lowerQuery.includes('parameswara') || lowerQuery.includes('pengasas melaka')) {
    return "🏰 Parameswara ialah pengasas Kesultanan Melayu Melaka pada tahun 1402. Beliau melarikan diri dari Palembang dan memilih lokasi strategik di Selat Melaka untuk membina empayar perdagangan yang hebat!";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('srivijaya') || lowerQuery.includes('funan') || lowerQuery.includes('majapahit')) {
    return " Srivijaya berpusat di Palembang, Funan di Indochina, dan Majapahit menguasai Nusantara. Semua kerajaan ini penting dalam sejarah Alam Melayu.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('adat perpatih') || lowerQuery.includes('negeri sembilan')) {
    return "🏛️ Negeri Sembilan mengamalkan Adat Perpatih yang bersifat matrilineal (mengikut garis ibu). Ini berbeza dengan Adat Temenggung yang patrilineal.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('sarawak') || lowerQuery.includes('sabah') || lowerQuery.includes('borneo')) {
    return "🌴 Sarawak dan Sabah mempunyai penduduk asal yang unik seperti Iban, Kadazan-Dusun, dan Bajau. Broke White memerintah Sarawak manakala Syarikat Borneo Utara British mentadbir Sabah.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('johor') || lowerQuery.includes('rio')) {
    return "🕌 Kesultanan Johor Riau diasaskan oleh Sultan Alauddin Riayat Shah II selepas kejatuhan Melaka. Ia menjadi pusat persuratan Melayu dan penyebaran Islam.";
  }
  
  // Default response for unmatched queries
  const defaults = [
    "🤔 Soalan yang menarik! Saya tidak mempunyai maklumat spesifik tentang itu dalam nota Tingkatan 2, tetapi saya cadangkan anda rujuk buku teks Sejarah atau tanya guru. Ada topik lain yang boleh saya bantu?",
    " Hmm, saya tidak pasti tentang perkara itu. Cuba tanya tentang topik seperti Kesultanan Melaka, Alam Melayu, atau Sarawak & Sabah. Saya lebih pakar dalam bidang tersebut!",
    "💡 Saya fokus pada nota Sejarah KSSM Tingkatan 2 (Bab 1-10). Jika soalan anda berkaitan dengan topik tersebut, cuba gunakan kata kunci yang lebih spesifik. Saya sedia membantu!"
  ];
  
  return defaults[Math.floor(Math.random() * defaults.length)];
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderCards();
  speechSynthesis.getVoices();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

    { q: "Seni bina tradisional Melayu yang sesuai dengan iklim tropika ialah?", options: ["Rumah batu", "Rumah panggung", "Rumah kaca", "Rumah konkrit"], answer: 1 },
    { q: "Portugis menakluki Melaka pada tahun?", options: ["1402", "1511", "1641", "1786"], answer: 1 },
    { q: "Kesultanan Johor Riau diasaskan oleh siapa?", options: ["Parameswara", "Sultan Alauddin Riayat Shah II", "Tun Perak", "Hang Jebat"], answer: 1 },
    { q: "Negeri Sembilan mengamalkan sistem adat apa?", options: ["Adat Temenggung", "Adat Perpatih", "Adat Istiadat", "Adat Resam"], answer: 1 }
  ]
};

let currentFilter = 'all';
let currentNoteIndex = 0;
let currentQuizForm = 't1';
let currentQuiz = 0;
let quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
let quizSubmitted = false;

function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') {
    body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    btn.textContent = '';
  } else {
    body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    btn.textContent = '☀️';
  }
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  notaData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    let show = true;
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) show = false;
    
    if (!show) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal(idx);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div>
      <div class="card-title">${item.title}</div>
      <span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

function openModal(idx) {
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = notaData[idx];
  
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = 'Tingkatan ' + item.form;
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  document.getElementById('modalDetail').textContent = item.detail;
  
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => {
    factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i+1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  stopSpeech();
}

function closeModalOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal();
}

function nextNote() {
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= notaData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(next);
}

function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = notaData[currentNoteIndex];
  const text = `${item.title}. ${item.note}. ${item.detail}. Fakta pertama: ${item.facts[0]}. Fakta kedua: ${item.facts[1]}. Fakta ketiga: ${item.facts[2]}.`;
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
  speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices();
}

// MULTI-FORM QUIZ FUNCTIONS
function switchQuizTab(form, btn) {
  currentQuizForm = form;
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('quizTitle').textContent = `📝 Kuiz Sejarah Tingkatan ${form === 't1' ? '1' : '2'}`;
  restartQuiz();
}

function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0;
  quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
  quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  renderQuiz();
}

function getCurrentQuizData() {
  return quizDataByForm[currentQuizForm];
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / data.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${data.length}`;
  
  let html = '';
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : '';
      html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65+j)}. ${opt}</button>`;
    });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  }
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya </button>`;
  } else {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) {
  if (quizSubmitted) return;
  quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx;
  renderQuiz();
}

function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { 
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } 
}

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0) {
    if (!confirm(`Anda masih belum menjawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar sekarang?`)) return;
  }
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  let score = 0;
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    const options = questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) score++;
  });
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/${data.length}`;
    let msg = '';
    const percentage = (score / data.length) * 100;
    if (percentage === 100) msg = ' Cemerlang! Anda menguasai Sejarah dengan baik!';
    else if (percentage >= 70) msg = '👏 Tahniah! Prestasi yang sangat baik!';
    else if (percentage >= 50) msg = ' Bagus! Teruskan usaha anda!';
    else msg = '💪 Jangan putus asa! Ulang kaji dan cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
  }, 1000);
}

// AI TUTOR FUNCTIONS
let isChatOpen = false;

function toggleChat() {
  isChatOpen = !isChatOpen;
  const chatWindow = document.getElementById('aiChatWindow');
  if (isChatOpen) {
    chatWindow.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('chatInput').focus();
  } else {
    chatWindow.classList.remove('active');
  }
}

function handleChatKey(event) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    sendChatMessage();
  }
}

function sendChatMessage() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
  const message = input.value.trim();
  if (!message) return;
  
  addChatMessage(message, 'user');
  input.value = '';
  
  // Show typing indicator
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'typing-indicator';
  typingDiv.id = 'typingIndicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div>';
  chatBody.appendChild(typingDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
  
  // Simulate AI thinking and respond
  setTimeout(() => {
    const typingEl = document.getElementById('typingIndicator');
    if (typingEl) typingEl.remove();
    
    const response = generateAIResponse(message);
    addChatMessage(response, 'bot');
  }, 1000 + Math.random() * 1000);
}

function addChatMessage(text, sender) {
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
  msgDiv.className = `chat-message msg-${sender}`;
  msgDiv.textContent = text;
  chatBody.appendChild(msgDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
}

function generateAIResponse(query) {
  const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
  
  // Check for greetings
  if (lowerQuery.includes('hai') || lowerQuery.includes('hello') || lowerQuery.includes('assalamualaikum')) {
    return "Waalaikumussalam! 👋 Selamat datang! Saya sedia membantu anda belajar Sejarah Tingkatan 1 & 2. Ada topik khusus yang anda ingin tahu?";
  }
  
  // Check for thanks
  if (lowerQuery.includes('terima kasih') || lowerQuery.includes('thanks')) {
    return "Sama-sama!  Sentiasa berusaha untuk cemerlang dalam Sejarah ya!";
  }
  
  // Search through notes for relevant keywords
  let bestMatch = null;
  let highestScore = 0;
  
  notaData.forEach(item => {
    let score = 0;
    const titleLower = item.title.toLowerCase();
    const noteLower = item.note.toLowerCase();
    const detailLower = item.detail.toLowerCase();
    const factsLower = item.facts.join(' ').toLowerCase();
    const allText = `${titleLower} ${noteLower} ${detailLower} ${factsLower}`;
    
    // Check if query words appear in the content
    const queryWords = lowerQuery.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 2);
    queryWords.forEach(word => {
      if (allText.includes(word)) score += 2;
      if (titleLower.includes(word)) score += 5;
    });
    
    if (score > highestScore) {
      highestScore = score;
      bestMatch = item;
    }
  });
  
  // If found a good match
  if (bestMatch && highestScore >= 3) {
    const responses = [
      `📚 Berdasarkan nota saya, tentang **${bestMatch.title}**: ${bestMatch.note}\n\n Tambahan: ${bestMatch.detail.substring(0, 150)}...`,
      ` Topik **${bestMatch.title}**:\n${bestMatch.note}\n\nFakta penting: ${bestMatch.facts[0]}`,
      `✨ Mengenai **${bestMatch.title}**, berikut adalah ringkasan:\n${bestMatch.note}\n\nAdakah anda ingin tahu lebih lanjut tentang fakta-faktanya?`
    ];
    return responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)];
  }
  
  // Specific keyword checks for common questions
  if (lowerQuery.includes('parameswara') || lowerQuery.includes('pengasas melaka')) {
    return " Parameswara ialah pengasas Kesultanan Melayu Melaka pada tahun 1402. Beliau melarikan diri dari Palembang dan memilih lokasi strategik di Selat Melaka untuk membina empayar perdagangan yang hebat!";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('prasejarah') || lowerQuery.includes('zaman batu')) {
    return "🪨 Zaman Prasejarah terbahagi kepada Palaeolitik, Neolitik, dan Zaman Logam. Di Malaysia, tapak penting termasuk Gua Niah di Sarawak dan Lembah Lenggong di Perak.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('islam') || lowerQuery.includes('nabi muhammad')) {
    return "☪️ Tamadun Islam bermula dengan wahyu kepada Nabi Muhammad SAW di Gua Hira'. Baghdad menjadi pusat ilmu pengetahuan dunia dengan sumbangan dalam algebra, astronomi, dan perubatan.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('srivijaya') || lowerQuery.includes('funan') || lowerQuery.includes('majapahit')) {
    return " Srivijaya berpusat di Palembang, Funan di Indochina, dan Majapahit menguasai Nusantara. Semua kerajaan ini penting dalam sejarah Alam Melayu (Tingkatan 2).";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('adat perpatih') || lowerQuery.includes('negeri sembilan')) {
    return "🏛️ Negeri Sembilan mengamalkan Adat Perpatih yang bersifat matrilineal (mengikut garis ibu). Ini berbeza dengan Adat Temenggung yang patrilineal.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('sarawak') || lowerQuery.includes('sabah') || lowerQuery.includes('borneo')) {
    return "🌴 Sarawak dan Sabah mempunyai penduduk asal yang unik seperti Iban, Kadazan-Dusun, dan Bajau. Broke White memerintah Sarawak manakala Syarikat Borneo Utara British mentadbir Sabah.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('tamadun') || lowerQuery.includes('mesir') || lowerQuery.includes('yunani')) {
    return "️ Tamadun awal dunia muncul di lembah sungai. Mesir Purba terkenal dengan piramid, Yunani dengan demokrasi, Rom dengan undang-undang, dan China dengan kertas serta kompas.";
  }
  
  // Default response for unmatched queries
  const defaults = [
    "🤔 Soalan yang menarik! Saya tidak mempunyai maklumat spesifik tentang itu dalam nota Tingkatan 1 & 2, tetapi saya cadangkan anda rujuk buku teks Sejarah atau tanya guru. Ada topik lain yang boleh saya bantu?",
    " Hmm, saya tidak pasti tentang perkara itu. Cuba tanya tentang topik seperti Zaman Prasejarah, Kesultanan Melaka, atau Alam Melayu. Saya lebih pakar dalam bidang tersebut!",
    " Saya fokus pada nota Sejarah KSSM Tingkatan 1 & 2. Jika soalan anda berkaitan dengan topik tersebut, cuba gunakan kata kunci yang lebih spesifik. Saya sedia membantu!"
  ];
  
  return defaults[Math.floor(Math.random() * defaults.length)];
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderCards();
  speechSynthesis.getVoices();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

let currentFilter = 'all';
let currentNoteIndex = 0;
let currentQuizForm = 't1';
let currentQuiz = 0;
let quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
let quizSubmitted = false;

function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') {
    body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    btn.textContent = '';
  } else {
    body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    btn.textContent = '☀️';
  }
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  notaData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    let show = true;
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) show = false;
    
    if (!show) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal(idx);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div>
      <div class="card-title">${item.title}</div>
      <span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

function openModal(idx) {
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = notaData[idx];
  
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = 'Tingkatan ' + item.form;
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  document.getElementById('modalDetail').textContent = item.detail;
  
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => {
    factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i+1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  stopSpeech();
}

function closeModalOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal();
}

function nextNote() {
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= notaData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(next);
}

function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = notaData[currentNoteIndex];
  const text = `${item.title}. ${item.note}. ${item.detail}. Fakta pertama: ${item.facts[0]}. Fakta kedua: ${item.facts[1]}. Fakta ketiga: ${item.facts[2]}.`;
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
  speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices();
}

// MULTI-FORM QUIZ FUNCTIONS
function switchQuizTab(form, btn) {
  currentQuizForm = form;
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  const formNum = form === 't1' ? '1' : form === 't2' ? '2' : '3';
  document.getElementById('quizTitle').textContent = `📝 Kuiz Sejarah Tingkatan ${formNum}`;
  restartQuiz();
}

function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0;
  quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
  quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  renderQuiz();
}

function getCurrentQuizData() {
  return quizDataByForm[currentQuizForm];
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / data.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${data.length}`;
  
  let html = '';
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : '';
      html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65+j)}. ${opt}</button>`;
    });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  }
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya </button>`;
  } else {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) {
  if (quizSubmitted) return;
  quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx;
  renderQuiz();
}

function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { 
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } 
}

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0) {
    if (!confirm(`Anda masih belum menjawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar sekarang?`)) return;
  }
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  let score = 0;
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    const options = questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) score++;
  });
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/${data.length}`;
    let msg = '';
    const percentage = (score / data.length) * 100;
    if (percentage === 100) msg = ' Cemerlang! Anda menguasai Sejarah dengan baik!';
    else if (percentage >= 70) msg = '👏 Tahniah! Prestasi yang sangat baik!';
    else if (percentage >= 50) msg = ' Bagus! Teruskan usaha anda!';
    else msg = '💪 Jangan putus asa! Ulang kaji dan cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
  }, 1000);
}

// AI TUTOR FUNCTIONS
let isChatOpen = false;

function toggleChat() {
  isChatOpen = !isChatOpen;
  const chatWindow = document.getElementById('aiChatWindow');
  if (isChatOpen) {
    chatWindow.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('chatInput').focus();
  } else {
    chatWindow.classList.remove('active');
  }
}

function handleChatKey(event) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    sendChatMessage();
  }
}

function sendChatMessage() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
  const message = input.value.trim();
  if (!message) return;
  
  addChatMessage(message, 'user');
  input.value = '';
  
  // Show typing indicator
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'typing-indicator';
  typingDiv.id = 'typingIndicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div>';
  chatBody.appendChild(typingDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
  
  // Simulate AI thinking and respond
  setTimeout(() => {
    const typingEl = document.getElementById('typingIndicator');
    if (typingEl) typingEl.remove();
    
    const response = generateAIResponse(message);
    addChatMessage(response, 'bot');
  }, 1000 + Math.random() * 1000);
}

function addChatMessage(text, sender) {
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
  msgDiv.className = `chat-message msg-${sender}`;
  msgDiv.textContent = text;
  chatBody.appendChild(msgDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
}

function generateAIResponse(query) {
  const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
  
  // Check for greetings
  if (lowerQuery.includes('hai') || lowerQuery.includes('hello') || lowerQuery.includes('assalamualaikum')) {
    return "Waalaikumussalam! 👋 Selamat datang! Saya sedia membantu anda belajar Sejarah Tingkatan 1, 2 & 3. Ada topik khusus yang anda ingin tahu?";
  }
  
  // Check for thanks
  if (lowerQuery.includes('terima kasih') || lowerQuery.includes('thanks')) {
    return "Sama-sama!  Sentiasa berusaha untuk cemerlang dalam Sejarah ya!";
  }
  
  // Search through notes for relevant keywords
  let bestMatch = null;
  let highestScore = 0;
  
  notaData.forEach(item => {
    let score = 0;
    const titleLower = item.title.toLowerCase();
    const noteLower = item.note.toLowerCase();
    const detailLower = item.detail.toLowerCase();
    const factsLower = item.facts.join(' ').toLowerCase();
    const allText = `${titleLower} ${noteLower} ${detailLower} ${factsLower}`;
    
    // Check if query words appear in the content
    const queryWords = lowerQuery.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 2);
    queryWords.forEach(word => {
      if (allText.includes(word)) score += 2;
      if (titleLower.includes(word)) score += 5;
    });
    
    if (score > highestScore) {
      highestScore = score;
      bestMatch = item;
    }
  });
  
  // If found a good match
  if (bestMatch && highestScore >= 3) {
    const responses = [
      `📚 Berdasarkan nota saya, tentang **${bestMatch.title}**: ${bestMatch.note}\n\n Tambahan: ${bestMatch.detail.substring(0, 150)}...`,
      ` Topik **${bestMatch.title}**:\n${bestMatch.note}\n\nFakta penting: ${bestMatch.facts[0]}`,
      `✨ Mengenai **${bestMatch.title}**, berikut adalah ringkasan:\n${bestMatch.note}\n\nAdakah anda ingin tahu lebih lanjut tentang fakta-faktanya?`
    ];
    return responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)];
  }
  
  // Specific keyword checks for common questions across all forms
  if (lowerQuery.includes('parameswara') || lowerQuery.includes('pengasas melaka')) {
    return " Parameswara ialah pengasas Kesultanan Melayu Melaka pada tahun 1402. Beliau melarikan diri dari Palembang dan memilih lokasi strategik di Selat Melaka untuk membina empayar perdagangan yang hebat!";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('prasejarah') || lowerQuery.includes('zaman batu')) {
    return " Zaman Prasejarah terbahagi kepada Palaeolitik, Neolitik, dan Zaman Logam. Di Malaysia, tapak penting termasuk Gua Niah di Sarawak dan Lembah Lenggong di Perak.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('islam') || lowerQuery.includes('nabi muhammad')) {
    return "☪️ Tamadun Islam bermula dengan wahyu kepada Nabi Muhammad SAW di Gua Hira'. Baghdad menjadi pusat ilmu pengetahuan dunia dengan sumbangan dalam algebra, astronomi, dan perubatan.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('srivijaya') || lowerQuery.includes('funan') || lowerQuery.includes('majapahit')) {
    return " Srivijaya berpusat di Palembang, Funan di Indochina, dan Majapahit menguasai Nusantara. Semua kerajaan ini penting dalam sejarah Alam Melayu (Tingkatan 2).";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('adat perpatih') || lowerQuery.includes('negeri sembilan')) {
    return "️ Negeri Sembilan mengamalkan Adat Perpatih yang bersifat matrilineal (mengikut garis ibu). Ini berbeza dengan Adat Temenggung yang patrilineal.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('sarawak') || lowerQuery.includes('sabah') || lowerQuery.includes('borneo')) {
    return "🌴 Sarawak dan Sabah mempunyai penduduk asal yang unik seperti Iban, Kadazan-Dusun, dan Bajau. Broke White memerintah Sarawak manakala Syarikat Borneo Utara British mentadbir Sabah.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('tamadun') || lowerQuery.includes('mesir') || lowerQuery.includes('yunani')) {
    return "️ Tamadun awal dunia muncul di lembah sungai. Mesir Purba terkenal dengan piramid, Yunani dengan demokrasi, Rom dengan undang-undang, dan China dengan kertas serta kompas.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('british') || lowerQuery.includes('penjajah') || lowerQuery.includes('resident')) {
    return "🇧 British memperkenalkan Sistem Residen di NNMB (Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang). NNS diperintah langsung manakala NNMTB mengekalkan autonomi lebih tinggi.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('merdeka') || lowerQuery.includes('kemerdekaan')) {
    return "🎉 Tanah Melayu mencapai kemerdekaan pada 31 Ogos 1957! Tunku Abdul Rahman Putra Al-Haj melaungkan 'Merdeka' sebanyak 7 kali di Stadium Merdeka.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('dol said') || lowerQuery.includes('naning') || lowerQuery.includes('mat salleh')) {
    return "⚔️ Dol Said memimpin Perang Naning (1831-1832) manakala Mat Salleh menentang British di Sabah. Penentangan ini menanam semangat nasionalisme walaupun kebanyakannya gagal.";
  }
  
  // Default response for unmatched queries
  const defaults = [
    "🤔 Soalan yang menarik! Saya tidak mempunyai maklumat spesifik tentang itu dalam nota Tingkatan 1, 2 & 3, tetapi saya cadangkan anda rujuk buku teks Sejarah atau tanya guru. Ada topik lain yang boleh saya bantu?",
    " Hmm, saya tidak pasti tentang perkara itu. Cuba tanya tentang topik seperti Zaman Prasejarah, Kesultanan Melaka, Pentadbiran British, atau Kemerdekaan. Saya lebih pakar dalam bidang tersebut!",
    " Saya fokus pada nota Sejarah KSSM Tingkatan 1, 2 & 3. Jika soalan anda berkaitan dengan topik tersebut, cuba gunakan kata kunci yang lebih spesifik. Saya sedia membantu!"
  ];
  
  return defaults[Math.floor(Math.random() * defaults.length)];
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderCards();
  speechSynthesis.getVoices();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

### ASSISTANT
Berikut adalah kod HTML lengkap yang telah dikemas kini. Saya telah menambah **5 jenis kuiz berbeza** untuk setiap tingkatan dengan jumlah soalan yang lebih banyak (10 soalan setiap satu), merangkumi pelbagai aspek silibus KSSM. Setiap jenis kuiz mempunyai fokus dan gaya soalan yang unik untuk menguji pemahaman pelajar secara menyeluruh.

      { q: "Perjanjian Bangkok 1909 menyerahkan empat negeri utara kepada?", options: ["Belanda", "British", "Portugis", "Sepanyol"], answer: 1 },
      { q: "Kod undang-undang bertulis diperkenalkan oleh Sultan Abu Bakar untuk?", options: ["Menghapuskan adat", "Pemodenan & kepastian undang-undang", "Menyerah kuasa", "Mengikut British sepenuhnya"], answer: 1 }
    ]
  }
};

let currentFilter = 'all';
let currentNoteIndex = 0;
let currentQuizForm = 't1';
let currentQuizType = 0;
let currentQuiz = 0;
let quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
let quizSubmitted = false;

const quizTypeNames = ['Asas', 'Kerajaan', 'Perjuangan', 'Ekonomi', 'Cabaran'];
const quizTypeIcons = ['', '🏰', '️', '💰', '🧠'];

function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') {
    body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    btn.textContent = '';
  } else {
    body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    btn.textContent = '☀️';
  }
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  notaData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    let show = true;
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) show = false;
    
    if (!show) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal(idx);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div>
      <div class="card-title">${item.title}</div>
      <span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

function openModal(idx) {
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = notaData[idx];
  
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = 'Tingkatan ' + item.form;
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  document.getElementById('modalDetail').textContent = item.detail;
  
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => {
    factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i+1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  stopSpeech();
}

function closeModalOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal();
}

function nextNote() {
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= notaData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(next);
}

function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = notaData[currentNoteIndex];
  const text = `${item.title}. ${item.note}. ${item.detail}. Fakta pertama: ${item.facts[0]}. Fakta kedua: ${item.facts[1]}. Fakta ketiga: ${item.facts[2]}.`;
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
  speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices();
}

// MULTI-FORM & MULTI-TYPE QUIZ FUNCTIONS
function switchQuizTab(form, btn) {
  currentQuizForm = form;
  currentQuizType = 0;
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  
  // Reset type tabs
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach((b, i) => {
    b.classList.toggle('active', i === 0);
  });
  
  updateQuizTitle();
  restartQuiz();
}

function switchQuizType(type, btn) {
  currentQuizType = type;
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  updateQuizTitle();
  restartQuiz();
}

function updateQuizTitle() {
  const formNum = currentQuizForm === 't1' ? '1' : currentQuizForm === 't2' ? '2' : '3';
  const typeName = quizTypeNames[currentQuizType];
  const typeIcon = quizTypeIcons[currentQuizType];
  document.getElementById('quizTitle').textContent = `${typeIcon} Kuiz ${typeName} Tingkatan ${formNum}`;
}

function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0;
  quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
  quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  renderQuiz();
}

function getCurrentQuizData() {
  return quizDataByForm[currentQuizForm][currentQuizType];
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / data.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${data.length}`;
  
  let html = '';
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : '';
      html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65+j)}. ${opt}</button>`;
    });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  }
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya </button>`;
  } else {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) {
  if (quizSubmitted) return;
  quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx;
  renderQuiz();
}

function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { 
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } 
}

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0) {
    if (!confirm(`Anda masih belum menjawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar sekarang?`)) return;
  }
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  let score = 0;
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    const options = questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) score++;
  });
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/${data.length}`;
    let msg = '';
    const percentage = (score / data.length) * 100;
    if (percentage === 100) msg = ' Cemerlang! Anda menguasai Sejarah dengan baik!';
    else if (percentage >= 70) msg = '👏 Tahniah! Prestasi yang sangat baik!';
    else if (percentage >= 50) msg = ' Bagus! Teruskan usaha anda!';
    else msg = '💪 Jangan putus asa! Ulang kaji dan cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
  }, 1000);
}

// AI TUTOR FUNCTIONS
let isChatOpen = false;

function toggleChat() {
  isChatOpen = !isChatOpen;
  const chatWindow = document.getElementById('aiChatWindow');
  if (isChatOpen) {
    chatWindow.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('chatInput').focus();
  } else {
    chatWindow.classList.remove('active');
  }
}

function handleChatKey(event) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    sendChatMessage();
  }
}

function sendChatMessage() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
  const message = input.value.trim();
  if (!message) return;
  
  addChatMessage(message, 'user');
  input.value = '';
  
  // Show typing indicator
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'typing-indicator';
  typingDiv.id = 'typingIndicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div>';
  chatBody.appendChild(typingDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
  
  // Simulate AI thinking and respond
  setTimeout(() => {
    const typingEl = document.getElementById('typingIndicator');
    if (typingEl) typingEl.remove();
    
    const response = generateAIResponse(message);
    addChatMessage(response, 'bot');
  }, 1000 + Math.random() * 1000);
}

function addChatMessage(text, sender) {
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
  msgDiv.className = `chat-message msg-${sender}`;
  msgDiv.textContent = text;
  chatBody.appendChild(msgDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
}

function generateAIResponse(query) {
  const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
  
  // Check for greetings
  if (lowerQuery.includes('hai') || lowerQuery.includes('hello') || lowerQuery.includes('assalamualaikum')) {
    return "Waalaikumussalam! 👋 Selamat datang! Saya sedia membantu anda belajar Sejarah Tingkatan 1, 2 & 3. Ada topik khusus yang anda ingin tahu?";
  }
  
  // Check for thanks
  if (lowerQuery.includes('terima kasih') || lowerQuery.includes('thanks')) {
    return "Sama-sama!  Sentiasa berusaha untuk cemerlang dalam Sejarah ya!";
  }
  
  // Search through notes for relevant keywords
  let bestMatch = null;
  let highestScore = 0;
  
  notaData.forEach(item => {
    let score = 0;
    const titleLower = item.title.toLowerCase();
    const noteLower = item.note.toLowerCase();
    const detailLower = item.detail.toLowerCase();
    const factsLower = item.facts.join(' ').toLowerCase();
    const allText = `${titleLower} ${noteLower} ${detailLower} ${factsLower}`;
    
    // Check if query words appear in the content
    const queryWords = lowerQuery.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 2);
    queryWords.forEach(word => {
      if (allText.includes(word)) score += 2;
      if (titleLower.includes(word)) score += 5;
    });
    
    if (score > highestScore) {
      highestScore = score;
      bestMatch = item;
    }
  });
  
  // If found a good match
  if (bestMatch && highestScore >= 3) {
    const responses = [
      `📚 Berdasarkan nota saya, tentang **${bestMatch.title}**: ${bestMatch.note}\n\n Tambahan: ${bestMatch.detail.substring(0, 150)}...`,
      ` Topik **${bestMatch.title}**:\n${bestMatch.note}\n\nFakta penting: ${bestMatch.facts[0]}`,
      `✨ Mengenai **${bestMatch.title}**, berikut adalah ringkasan:\n${bestMatch.note}\n\nAdakah anda ingin tahu lebih lanjut tentang fakta-faktanya?`
    ];
    return responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)];
  }
  
  // Specific keyword checks for common questions across all forms
  if (lowerQuery.includes('parameswara') || lowerQuery.includes('pengasas melaka')) {
    return " Parameswara ialah pengasas Kesultanan Melayu Melaka pada tahun 1402. Beliau melarikan diri dari Palembang dan memilih lokasi strategik di Selat Melaka untuk membina empayar perdagangan yang hebat!";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('prasejarah') || lowerQuery.includes('zaman batu')) {
    return " Zaman Prasejarah terbahagi kepada Palaeolitik, Neolitik, dan Zaman Logam. Di Malaysia, tapak penting termasuk Gua Niah di Sarawak dan Lembah Lenggong di Perak.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('islam') || lowerQuery.includes('nabi muhammad')) {
    return "☪️ Tamadun Islam bermula dengan wahyu kepada Nabi Muhammad SAW di Gua Hira'. Baghdad menjadi pusat ilmu pengetahuan dunia dengan sumbangan dalam algebra, astronomi, dan perubatan.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('srivijaya') || lowerQuery.includes('funan') || lowerQuery.includes('majapahit')) {
    return " Srivijaya berpusat di Palembang, Funan di Indochina, dan Majapahit menguasai Nusantara. Semua kerajaan ini penting dalam sejarah Alam Melayu (Tingkatan 2).";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('adat perpatih') || lowerQuery.includes('negeri sembilan')) {
    return "️ Negeri Sembilan mengamalkan Adat Perpatih yang bersifat matrilineal (mengikut garis ibu). Ini berbeza dengan Adat Temenggung yang patrilineal.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('sarawak') || lowerQuery.includes('sabah') || lowerQuery.includes('borneo')) {
    return "🌴 Sarawak dan Sabah mempunyai penduduk asal yang unik seperti Iban, Kadazan-Dusun, dan Bajau. Broke White memerintah Sarawak manakala Syarikat Borneo Utara British mentadbir Sabah.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('tamadun') || lowerQuery.includes('mesir') || lowerQuery.includes('yunani')) {
    return "️ Tamadun awal dunia muncul di lembah sungai. Mesir Purba terkenal dengan piramid, Yunani dengan demokrasi, Rom dengan undang-undang, dan China dengan kertas serta kompas.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('british') || lowerQuery.includes('penjajah') || lowerQuery.includes('resident')) {
    return "🇧 British memperkenalkan Sistem Residen di NNMB (Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang). NNS diperintah langsung manakala NNMTB mengekalkan autonomi lebih tinggi.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('merdeka') || lowerQuery.includes('kemerdekaan')) {
    return "🎉 Tanah Melayu mencapai kemerdekaan pada 31 Ogos 1957! Tunku Abdul Rahman Putra Al-Haj melaungkan 'Merdeka' sebanyak 7 kali di Stadium Merdeka.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('dol said') || lowerQuery.includes('naning') || lowerQuery.includes('mat salleh')) {
    return "⚔️ Dol Said memimpin Perang Naning (1831-1832) manakala Mat Salleh menentang British di Sabah. Penentangan ini menanam semangat nasionalisme walaupun kebanyakannya gagal.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('abu bakar') || lowerQuery.includes('johor')) {
    return " Sultan Abu Bakar Johor melaksanakan pemodenan melalui penubuhan Majlis Mesyuarat Negeri dan kod undang-undang bertulis. Beliau mengekalkan kedaulatan Johor sambil memodenkan pentadbiran.";
  }
  
  if (lowerQuery.includes('revolusi industri') || lowerQuery.includes('kuasa barat')) {
    return "🚢 Revolusi Perindustrian di Eropah meningkatkan permintaan terhadap bijih timah, getah, dan rempah ratus. Ini menjadi faktor utama kedatangan kuasa Barat ke Tanah Melayu.";
  }
  
  // Default response for unmatched queries
  const defaults = [
    "🤔 Soalan yang menarik! Saya tidak mempunyai maklumat spesifik tentang itu dalam nota Tingkatan 1, 2 & 3, tetapi saya cadangkan anda rujuk buku teks Sejarah atau tanya guru. Ada topik lain yang boleh saya bantu?",
    " Hmm, saya tidak pasti tentang perkara itu. Cuba tanya tentang topik seperti Zaman Prasejarah, Kesultanan Melaka, Pentadbiran British, atau Kemerdekaan. Saya lebih pakar dalam bidang tersebut!",
    " Saya fokus pada nota Sejarah KSSM Tingkatan 1, 2 & 3. Jika soalan anda berkaitan dengan topik tersebut, cuba gunakan kata kunci yang lebih spesifik. Saya sedia membantu!"
  ];
  
  return defaults[Math.floor(Math.random() * defaults.length)];
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderCards();
  speechSynthesis.getVoices();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

AI kini boleh menjawab soalan tentang sejarah di luar silibus KSSM sambil tetap memberi tumpuan kepada nota-nota dalam aplikasi.

let currentFilter = 'all';
let currentNoteIndex = 0;
let currentQuizForm = 't1';
let currentQuizType = 0;
let currentQuiz = 0;
let quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
let quizSubmitted = false;

const quizTypeNames = ['Asas', 'Kerajaan', 'Perjuangan', 'Ekonomi', 'Cabaran'];
const quizTypeIcons = ['', '🏰', '⚔️', '💰', '🧠'];

function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') {
    body.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    btn.textContent = '🌙';
  } else {
    body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
    btn.textContent = '☀️';
  }
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  notaData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    let show = true;
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) show = false;
    
    if (!show) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal(idx);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div>
      <div class="card-title">${item.title}</div>
      <span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

function openModal(idx) {
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = notaData[idx];
  
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = 'Tingkatan ' + item.form;
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  document.getElementById('modalDetail').textContent = item.detail;
  
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => {
    factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i+1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`;
  });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  stopSpeech();
}

function closeModalOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal();
}

function nextNote() {
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= notaData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(next);
}

function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = notaData[currentNoteIndex];
  const text = `${item.title}. ${item.note}. ${item.detail}. Fakta pertama: ${item.facts[0]}. Fakta kedua: ${item.facts[1]}. Fakta ketiga: ${item.facts[2]}.`;
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY';
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 1;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() {
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
}

if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
  speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices();
}

// MULTI-FORM & MULTI-TYPE QUIZ FUNCTIONS
function switchQuizTab(form, btn) {
  currentQuizForm = form;
  currentQuizType = 0;
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  
  // Reset type tabs
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach((b, i) => {
    b.classList.toggle('active', i === 0);
  });
  
  updateQuizTitle();
  restartQuiz();
}

function switchQuizType(type, btn) {
  currentQuizType = type;
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  updateQuizTitle();
  restartQuiz();
}

function updateQuizTitle() {
  const formNum = currentQuizForm === 't1' ? '1' : currentQuizForm === 't2' ? '2' : '3';
  const typeName = quizTypeNames[currentQuizType];
  const typeIcon = quizTypeIcons[currentQuizType];
  document.getElementById('quizTitle').textContent = `${typeIcon} Kuiz ${typeName} Tingkatan ${formNum}`;
}

function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0;
  quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
  quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  renderQuiz();
}

function getCurrentQuizData() {
  return quizDataByForm[currentQuizForm][currentQuizType];
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / data.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${data.length}`;
  
  let html = '';
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      <h3>${i+1}. ${q.q}</h3>
      <div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : '';
      html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65+j)}. ${opt}</button>`;
    });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;"> Sebelum</button>`;
  }
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya ➡</button>`;
  } else {
    navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) {
  if (quizSubmitted) return;
  quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx;
  renderQuiz();
}

function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { 
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } 
}

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0) {
    if (!confirm(`Anda masih belum menjawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar sekarang?`)) return;
  }
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  const data = getCurrentQuizData();
  let score = 0;
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    const options = questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');
    options.forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) score++;
  });
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/${data.length}`;
    let msg = '';
    const percentage = (score / data.length) * 100;
    if (percentage === 100) msg = '🌟 Cemerlang! Anda menguasai Sejarah dengan baik!';
    else if (percentage >= 70) msg = ' Tahniah! Prestasi yang sangat baik!';
    else if (percentage >= 50) msg = '👍 Bagus! Teruskan usaha anda!';
    else msg = '💪 Jangan putus asa! Ulang kaji dan cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
  }, 1000);
}

// AI TUTOR FUNCTIONS
let isChatOpen = false;

function toggleChat() {
  isChatOpen = !isChatOpen;
  const chatWindow = document.getElementById('aiChatWindow');
  if (isChatOpen) {
    chatWindow.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('chatInput').focus();
  } else {
    chatWindow.classList.remove('active');
  }
}

function handleChatKey(event) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    sendChatMessage();
  }
}

function sendChatMessage() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
  const message = input.value.trim();
  if (!message) return;
  
  addChatMessage(message, 'user');
  input.value = '';
  
  // Show typing indicator
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'typing-indicator';
  typingDiv.id = 'typingIndicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div>';
  chatBody.appendChild(typingDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
  
  // Simulate AI thinking and respond
  setTimeout(() => {
    const typingEl = document.getElementById('typingIndicator');
    if (typingEl) typingEl.remove();
    
    const response = generateAIResponse(message);
    addChatMessage(response, 'bot');
  }, 1000 + Math.random() * 1000);
}

function addChatMessage(text, sender) {
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
  msgDiv.className = `chat-message msg-${sender}`;
  msgDiv.textContent = text;
  chatBody.appendChild(msgDiv);
  chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
}
