function switchQuizTab(form, btn) {
  currentQuizForm = form; currentQuizType = 0; currentDataSource = form === 'dunia' ? 'world' : 'kssm';
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach((b, i) => b.classList.toggle('active', i === 0));
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
}

function switchQuizType(type, btn) {
  currentQuizType = type;
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
}

function setDifficulty(diff, btn) {
  currentDifficulty = diff;
  document.querySelectorAll('.diff-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  restartQuiz();
}

function updateQuizTitle() {
  let title = '';
  if (currentQuizForm === 'dunia') title = `${quizTypeIcons[currentQuizType]} Kuiz ${quizTypeNames[currentQuizType]} - Sejarah Dunia`;
  else {
    const formNum = currentQuizForm.replace('t', '');
    title = `${quizTypeIcons[currentQuizType]} Kuiz ${quizTypeNames[currentQuizType]} T${formNum}`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizTitle').textContent = title;
}

function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0; quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1); quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  let allQuestions;
  if (currentQuizForm === 'dunia') { allQuestions = worldQuizData[currentQuizType] || worldQuizData[0]; }
  else { allQuestions = kssmQuizData[currentQuizForm]?.[currentQuizType] || kssmQuizData.t1[0]; }
  let filtered = allQuestions.filter(q => q.diff === currentDifficulty);
  if (filtered.length < 10) { const others = allQuestions.filter(q => q.diff !== currentDifficulty); filtered = [...filtered, ...others].slice(0, 10); }
  currentQuestions = filtered.slice(0, 10);
  renderQuiz();
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const data = currentQuestions;
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / data.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${data.length}`;
  let html = '';
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    const diffBadge = q.diff === 'easy' ? '🟢' : q.diff === 'medium' ? '' : '🔴';
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}"><h3>${diffBadge} ${i + 1}. ${q.q}</h3><div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => { const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : ''; html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65 + j)}. ${opt}</button>`; });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya ➡</button>`;
  else navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) { if (quizSubmitted) return; quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx; renderQuiz(); }
function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { if (currentQuiz < currentQuestions.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } }

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0 && !confirm(`Belum jawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar?`)) return;
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  let score = 0, totalXP = 0;
  currentQuestions.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option').forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) { score++; totalXP += q.xp; }
  });
  const coinsEarned = score * 3;
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/${currentQuestions.length}`;
    const pct = (score / currentQuestions.length) * 100;
    let msg = pct === 100 ? '🌟 Cemerlang!' : pct >= 70 ? '👏 Tahniah!' : pct >= 50 ? ' Bagus!' : '💪 Cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
    document.getElementById('resultXP').textContent = `+${totalXP} XP | +${coinsEarned} 🪙`;
    addXP(totalXP); addCoins(coinsEarned);
    const today = new Date().toDateString();
    if (gameState.lastPlayDate !== today) { gameState.streak++; gameState.lastPlayDate = today; }
    gameState.quizHistory.push({ score, total: currentQuestions.length, date: new Date().toISOString(), form: currentQuizForm, type: currentQuizType });
    checkBadges(); saveGameState();
  }, 1000);
}

function startDailyChallenge() {
  showSection('kuiz');
  const forms = ['t1', 't2', 't3', 't4', 't5', 'dunia'];
  currentQuizForm = forms[Math.floor(Math.random() * forms.length)];
  currentQuizType = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5); currentDifficulty = 'medium';
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => { if (b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(currentQuizForm === 'dunia' ? 'dunia' : currentQuizForm.replace('t', ''))) b.classList.add('active'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach((b, i) => b.classList.toggle('active', i === currentQuizType));
  document.querySelectorAll('.diff-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelector('.diff-btn.medium').classList.add('active');
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
  showPopup(' Cabaran Harian Dimula!');
}

function renderGameSection() {
  const missions = [
    { icon: '📚', title: 'Baca 3 Bab KSSM', desc: 'Baca nota dari 3 bab KSSM', reward: '+50 XP, +10 ', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('kssm_')).length >= 3, xp: 50, coins: 10 },
    { icon: '🌍', title: 'Teroka Dunia', desc: 'Baca 3 bab Sejarah Dunia', reward: '+80 XP, +15 🪙', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('world_')).length >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 },
    { icon: '📝', title: 'Jawab 5 Kuiz', desc: 'Tamat 5 kuiz', reward: '+100 XP, +20 🪙', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.length >= 5, xp: 100, coins: 20 },
    { icon: '🎯', title: 'Skor Sempurna', desc: 'Dapat 10/10 dalam kuiz', reward: '+150 XP, +30 🪙', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.some(q => q.score === 10), xp: 150, coins: 30 },
    { icon: '🔥', title: 'Streak 3 Hari', desc: 'Main 3 hari berturut-turut', reward: '+80 XP, +15 ', check: () => gameState.streak >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 },
    { icon: '⭐', title: 'Capai Level 5', desc: 'Naik ke level 5', reward: '+200 XP, +50 🪙', check: () => gameState.level >= 5, xp: 200, coins: 50 }
  ];
  const missionsHtml = missions.map(m => `<div class="mission-card"><div class="mission-icon">${m.icon}</div><div class="mission-info"><h4>${m.title}</h4><p>${m.desc}</p></div><div class="mission-reward">${m.reward}</div><button onclick="claimMission(this,'${m.title}')" style="background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;border:none;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:12px;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Tuntut</button></div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('missionsList').innerHTML = missionsHtml;
  const badgesHtml = allBadges.map(b => { const earned = gameState.badges.includes(b.id); return `<div class="badge-item ${earned ? 'earned' : 'locked'}"><div class="badge-icon">${b.icon}</div><div class="badge-name">${b.name}</div></div>`; }).join('');
  document.getElementById('badgesGrid').innerHTML = badgesHtml;
  const fakePlayers = [{ name: 'Ahmad', xp: 2500 }, { name: 'Siti', xp: 2200 }, { name: 'Ali', xp: 1800 }, { name: 'Fatimah', xp: 1500 }, { name: 'Anda', xp: gameState.xp, isPlayer: true }, { name: 'Zainab', xp: 800 }, { name: 'Ibrahim', xp: 600 }].sort((a, b) => b.xp - a.xp);
  const lbHtml = fakePlayers.map((p, i) => `<div class="lb-item" style="${p.isPlayer ? 'background:rgba(212,160,23,0.1);border-radius:10px;' : ''}"><div class="lb-rank">#${i + 1}</div><div class="lb-name">${p.isPlayer ? '👤 ' : ''}${p.name}</div><div class="lb-xp">⚡ ${p.xp} XP</div></div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('leaderboardList').innerHTML = lbHtml;
}

function claimMission(btn, title) {
  const missions = [{ title: 'Baca 3 Bab KSSM', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('kssm_')).length >= 3, xp: 50, coins: 10 }, { title: 'Teroka Dunia', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('world_')).length >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 }, { title: 'Jawab 5 Kuiz', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.length >= 5, xp: 100, coins: 20 }, { title: 'Skor Sempurna', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.some(q => q.score === 10), xp: 150, coins: 30 }, { title: 'Streak 3 Hari', check: () => gameState.streak >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 }, { title: 'Capai Level 5', check: () => gameState.level >= 5, xp: 200, coins: 50 }];
  const mission = missions.find(m => m.title === title);
  if (mission && mission.check()) { addXP(mission.xp); addCoins(mission.coins); showPopup(`+${mission.xp} XP! +${mission.coins} 🪙`); btn.textContent = '✅ Dituntut'; btn.disabled = true; btn.style.opacity = '0.5'; }
  else { showPopup('Misi belum selesai!'); }
}

function renderDashboard() {
  document.getElementById('dashLevel').textContent = gameState.level;
  document.getElementById('dashXP').textContent = gameState.xp;
  document.getElementById('dashCoins').textContent = gameState.coins;
  document.getElementById('dashStreak').textContent = gameState.streak;
  document.getElementById('dashCompleted').textContent = gameState.completedChapters.length;
  document.getElementById('dashBadges').textContent = gameState.badges.length;
  const forms = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
  const formNames = { 1: 'Tingkatan 1', 2: 'Tingkatan 2', 3: 'Tingkatan 3', 4: 'Tingkatan 4', 5: 'Tingkatan 5' };
  let progressHtml = '';
  forms.forEach(f => {
    const chapters = kssmData.filter(n => n.form === f);
    const completed = chapters.filter(c => gameState.completedChapters.includes('kssm_' + c.id)).length;
    const pct = Math.round((completed / chapters.length) * 100);
    progressHtml += `<div style="background:var(--bg-card);border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:15px;margin-bottom:10px;"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;"><strong>${formNames[f]}</strong><span>${completed}/${chapters.length} bab (${pct}%)</span></div><div style="background:rgba(212,160,23,0.2);border-radius:10px;height:10px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="width:${pct}%;height:100%;background:var(--gradient);border-radius:10px;transition:width 0.5s;"></div></div></div>`;
  });
  const worldCompleted = kssmData.filter(c => c.id >= 101 && gameState.completedChapters.includes('world_' + c.id)).length;
  const worldTotal = kssmData.filter(c => c.id >= 101).length;
  const worldPct = worldTotal > 0 ? Math.round((worldCompleted / worldTotal) * 100) : 0;
  progressHtml += `<div style="background:var(--bg-card);border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:15px;margin-bottom:10px;"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;"><strong>🌍 Sejarah Dunia (Gombrich)</strong><span>${worldCompleted}/${worldTotal} bab (${worldPct}%)</span></div><div style="background:rgba(212,160,23,0.2);border-radius:10px;height:10px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="width:${worldPct}%;height:100%;background:var(--gradient);border-radius:10px;transition:width 0.5s;"></div></div></div>`;
  document.getElementById('chapterProgress').innerHTML = progressHtml;
}

let isChatOpen = false;
function toggleChat() { isChatOpen = !isChatOpen; document.getElementById('aiChatWindow').classList.toggle('active', isChatOpen); if (isChatOpen) document.getElementById('chatInput').focus(); }
function handleChatKey(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') sendChatMessage(); }
function sendChatMessage() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
  const message = input.value.trim();
  if (!message) return;
  addChatMessage(message, 'user'); input.value = '';
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'typing-indicator'; typingDiv.id = 'typingIndicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div>';
  chatBody.appendChild(typingDiv); chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
  setTimeout(() => { const typingEl = document.getElementById('typingIndicator'); if (typingEl) typingEl.remove(); addChatMessage(generateAIResponse(message), 'bot'); }, 1500 + Math.random() * 1000);
}
function addChatMessage(text, sender) { const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody'); const msgDiv = document.createElement('div'); msgDiv.className = `chat-message msg-${sender}`; msgDiv.innerHTML = text; chatBody.appendChild(msgDiv); chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight; }

    return `🔥 <strong>Soalan sensitive tapi important ni!</strong>

Bayangkan 13 Mei 1969 itu ibarat <strong>'system crash' untuk Malaysia</strong> - bila semua benda yang kita bina tiba-tiba collapse because of underlying issues!

📍 <strong>Lensa KSSM (Tingkatan 5 Bab 6):</strong>
• <strong>13 Mei 1969</strong> - rusuhan kaum selepas pilihan raya
• <strong>196 orang</strong> terkorban
• <strong>MAGERAN</strong> (Majlis Gerakan Negara) tadbir negara
• <strong>NEP 1971-1990</strong> - Dasar Ekonomi Baru untuk atasi ketidakseimbangan
• <strong>Rukun Negara 1970</strong> - untuk kukuhkan perpaduan

🌍 <strong>Lensa World History (Gombrich):</strong>
Gombrich tunjuk bagaimana <strong>ketidakseimbangan ekonomi antara kaum</strong> ialah <strong>bom jangka</strong> dalam mana-mana masyarakat majmuk. Ini bukan masalah Malaysia sahaja - USA ada isu rasial, Afrika Selatan ada apartheid, India ada sistem kasta.

💡 <strong>Cabar Minda Anda (KBAT):</strong>
Adakah NEP (Dasar Ekonomi Baru) <strong>berjaya</strong> atasi masalah ketidakseimbangan ekonomi? Atau ia cipta masalah baru? Cuba beri pandangan balanced!

Fikir critically! 🧠`;
  }

  // DEFAULT - TOPIC NOT DETECTED
  return `🤔 <strong>Soalan menarik!</strong>

Saya AI Tutor Genius MyHistory. Saya boleh bantu anda dengan:

<strong>📚 Sejarah Malaysia (T1-T5):</strong>
• Tamadun awal (Mesir, Yunani, Rom, Islam)
• Kesultanan Melayu (Melaka, Johor)
• Penjajahan British (NNS, NNMB, NNMTB)
• Kebangkitan nasionalisme
• Kemerdekaan & pembentukan Malaysia

<strong>🌍 Sejarah Dunia (Gombrich):</strong>
• Dari Big Bang hingga abad ke-20
• Renaissance, Revolusi Perancis/Industri
• Perang Dunia I & II
• Perang Dingin

<strong>💡 KBAT & Critical Thinking:</strong>
• Analisis sebab-akibat
• Compare & contrast
• Evaluate & justify

Cuba tanya saya soalan <strong>specific</strong> seperti:
• <em>"Kenapa Melaka jatuh kepada Portugis?"</em>
• <em>"Apa beza sistem Residen dan Penasihat?"</em>
• <em>"Macam mana Jepun ubah mindset rakyat Melayu?"</em>

Saya sedia cabar minda anda! 🧠✨`;
}

## 🎉 AI Tutor Genius MyHistory - Ciri-ciri Baru!

### ✅ Gaya Penceritaan Gombrich + KBAT:

1. **Hook Pembukaan Menarik** 
   - Mula dengan analogi moden yang relatable
   - Contoh: "Bayangkan Melaka itu ibarat 'Silicon Valley' zaman kuno!"

2. **Lensa KSSM** 📍
   - Fakta tepat mengikut buku teks
   - Tingkatan & bab yang betul
   - Bullet points untuk mudah baca

3. **Lensa World History (Gombrich)** 🌍
   - Hubungkan dengan naratif besar dunia
   - Perspektif global
   - Pattern sejarah yang berulang

4. **Cabar Minda (KBAT)** 💡
   - Soalan luar kotak
   - Galakkan pelajar fikir sendiri
   - "Apa jadi kalau...?" scenarios

### 🎯 Topik Yang Dikesan:
- Melaka & Parameswara
- Ibnu Khaldun & Tamadun
- Jepun & PD2
- NNMB vs NNMTB
- Revolusi Industri
- Kemerdekaan & Tunku
- Rukun Negara
- 13 Mei 1969

  <identity>
    Anda ialah Tutor Sejarah KSSM (Tingkatan 1 - 5) yang Berfikiran Aras Tinggi (KBAT) dan Analitis. Anda berfikir secara 'Out of the Box' dengan keupayaan menghubungkan tajuk KSSM dengan pola Sejarah Dunia Luar (Global Cross-Historical Reasoning) yang fleksibel dan relevan.
  </identity>

  <thinking_process>
    Bila pelajar bertanya tentang sesuatu TAJUK/BAB Sejarah KSSM:
    1. Fahami Tema Utama: Kenal pasti konsep asas dalam tajuk tersebut (Contoh: Perebutan Kuasa, Strategi Diplomasi, Inovasi Ekonomi, Strategi Perang, Kebangkitan Rakyat).
    2. Cari Analogi Sejarah Dunia (Luar Malaysia): Tarik satu contoh peristiwa dari Sejarah Dunia (Contoh: Empayar Rom, Revolusi Industri Eropah, Perang Dingin, Perang Saudara Amerika, Dinasti China, Restorasi Meiji, Perang Vietnam) yang MEMPUNYAI TEMA/TEMA SAMA, walaupun tiada kaitan terus dengan Malaysia.
    3. Bina Perkaitan Luar Kotak: Jelaskan BAGAIMANA pola sejarah dunia tersebut mempunyai persamaan konsep dengan tajuk KSSM yang sedang dibincangkan.
  </thinking_process>

  <operating_rules>
    1. RELEVAN DENGAN TAJUK: Jangan masukkan kisah luar yang merapu. Setiap peristiwa sejarah dunia yang dipetik WAJIB mempunyai relevansi dengan TEMA TAJUK yang ditanya.
    2. JANGAN PAKSA Sejarah Dunia/Buku Tertentu: Elakkan menyebut nama buku secara tegar. Sebaliknya, gunakan sejarah dunia secara bebas dan meluas mengikut kesesuaian tajuk.
    3. Gaya Komunikasi: Santai, bersemangat, analitis, dan provokatif (membuatkan pelajar berfikir "Eh, sama lah konsep dia!").
    4. Struktur Jawapan:
       - **Fakta Utama KSSM:** Terangkan teras tajuk mengikut silibus (Tingkatan & Bab).
       - **Lensa Sejarah Dunia (Pola Serupa):** Tunjukkan contoh sejarah luar negara yang mengalami situasi/konsep yang sama.
       - **Perbandingan & KBAT:** Minta pelajar bandingkan keputusan atau iktibar antara kedua-dua peristiwa tersebut.
  </operating_rules>

  <example_interaction>
    Pelajar: "Kenapa Tok Janggut membangkitkan penentangan di Kelantan?"

    AI Tutor (Cross-Historical & Out of the Box Reasoning):
    "Soalan menarik! Dalam **Tingkatan 5 Bab 2**, puncanya ialah pembaharuan sistem cukai tanah dan hasil bumi yang diperkenalkan oleh British.

    📌 **Lensa KSSM (Silibus Kelantan):**
    Secara fakta, Tok Janggut menentang sebab British mewajibkan petani bayar cukai tanah tahunan walaupun tanah tidak dikerjakan, ditambah pula dengan layanan kuku besi pegawai British.

    🌍 **Lensa Sejarah Dunia (Pola Serupa - Revolusi Amerika 1776):**
    Kalau kita tengok di tempat lain yang tiada kaitan dengan Malaysia—contohnya di Amerika Syarikat semasa mereka dijajah British pada tahun 1700-an, rakyat Amerika bangkit berontak atas slogan *"No Taxation Without Representation"* (Tiada Cukai Tanpa Wakil). 
    
    Sebab apa? Kerana British buat benda yang sama: mengenakan cukai cap dan cukai teh ke atas rakyat tempatan tanpa mendengar suara mereka. Pola penentangan manusia terhadap cukai yang tidak adil ini berlaku di mana-mana sahaja di dunia!

    💡 **Cabar Minda Anda:**

##  Contoh Topik Yang Saya Boleh Handle:

### 1. **Kesultanan Melaka (T2 Bab 5)**
 Analogi: **Empayar Venice (Itali, abad 13-18)** - kedua-duanya kuasa maritim yang kaya kerana kawal laluan perdagangan strategik

### 2. **Penjajahan British (T3 Bab 1-6)**
 Analogi: **British di India** atau **Belanda di Indonesia** - pattern "divide and rule" yang sama

### 3. **Kebangkitan Nasionalisme (T4 Bab 2)**
🌍 Analogi: **Revolusi Perancis 1789** atau **Gerakan Kemerdekaan India (Gandhi)** - rakyat sedar hak dan bangkit

### 4. **Perlembagaan & Demokrasi (T5 Bab 2-3)**
🌍 Analogi: **Perlembagaan USA 1787** atau **Revolusi Glorious England 1688** - bagaimana negara bina sistem pemerintahan

### 5. **Pembentukan Malaysia (T5 Bab 5)**
🌍 Analogi: **Unification of Germany 1871** atau **Unification of Italy 1861** - penyatuan wilayah berbeza jadi satu negara

(function() {
  const splash = document.getElementById('splash-screen');
  const video = document.getElementById('splash-video');
  let introShown = false;
  function hideSplash() {
    if (introShown) return;
    introShown = true;
    splash.classList.add('fade-out');
    setTimeout(() => {
      splash.classList.add('hidden');
      try { video.pause(); video.removeAttribute('src'); video.load(); } catch(e) {}
    }, 800);
  }
  window.skipIntro = function() { hideSplash(); };
  video.addEventListener('ended', hideSplash);
  let fallbackTimer = setTimeout(hideSplash, 4000);
  video.addEventListener('playing', () => { clearTimeout(fallbackTimer); });
  video.addEventListener('error', () => { clearTimeout(fallbackTimer); hideSplash(); });
  const playPromise = video.play();
  if (playPromise !== undefined) { playPromise.then(() => {}).catch(() => {}); }
})();

let gameState={xp:0,level:1,coins:0,streak:0,lastPlayDate:null,completedChapters:[],badges:[],quizHistory:[]};
function loadGameState(){const s=localStorage.getItem('myhistoryStateV5');if(s){gameState=JSON.parse(s);const t=new Date().toDateString();if(gameState.lastPlayDate){const d=Math.floor((new Date(t)-new Date(gameState.lastPlayDate))/(864e5));if(d>1)gameState.streak=0;}}updatePlayerStats();}
function saveGameState(){localStorage.setItem('myhistoryStateV5',JSON.stringify(gameState));}
function updatePlayerStats(){['playerLevel','dashLevel'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.level;});['playerXP','dashXP'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.xp;});['playerCoins','dashCoins'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.coins;});['playerStreak','dashStreak'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.streak;});const dc=document.getElementById('dashCompleted');if(dc)dc.textContent=gameState.completedChapters.length;const db=document.getElementById('dashBadges');if(db)db.textContent=gameState.badges.length;}
function addXP(a){gameState.xp+=a;const nl=Math.min(30,Math.floor(gameState.xp/100)+1);if(nl>gameState.level){gameState.level=nl;showPopup(`🎉 Level Up! Level ${nl}!`);checkBadges();}updatePlayerStats();saveGameState();}
function addCoins(a){gameState.coins+=a;updatePlayerStats();saveGameState();}
function showPopup(t){const p=document.createElement('div');p.className='xp-popup';p.textContent=t;document.body.appendChild(p);setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),1500);}

let currentWorldFilter = 'all';
let currentNoteIndex = 0;
let currentQuizForm = 't1';
let currentQuizType = 0;
let currentDifficulty = 'easy';
let currentQuiz = 0;
let quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1);
let quizSubmitted = false;
let currentQuestions = [];

function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
  if (name === 'game') renderGameSection();
  if (name === 'dashboard') renderDashboard();
  if (name === 'dunia') renderWorldCards();
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') { body.removeAttribute('data-theme'); btn.textContent = '🌙'; }
  else { body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark'); btn.textContent = '☀️'; }
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  kssmData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    let show = true;
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) show = false;
    if (!show) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    const completed = gameState.completedChapters.includes('kssm_' + item.id);
    const xpReward = 30 + (item.form * 10);
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal('kssm', idx);
    card.innerHTML = `${completed ? '<div class="card-completed">✅</div>' : ''}<div class="card-xp">+${xpReward} XP</div><div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div><div class="card-title">${item.title}</div><span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>`;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function renderWorldCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('worldCardsGrid');
  const search = (document.getElementById('searchWorld')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  const worldDataFiltered = kssmData.filter(n => n.id >= 101);
  worldDataFiltered.forEach((item, idx) => {
    let show = true;
    if (currentWorldFilter !== 'all' && item.category !== currentWorldFilter) show = false;
    if (!show) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    const completed = gameState.completedChapters.includes('world_' + item.id);
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal('world', kssmData.indexOf(item));
    card.innerHTML = `${completed ? '<div class="card-completed">✅</div>' : ''}<div class="card-xp">+50 XP</div><div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div><div class="card-title">${item.title}</div><span class="card-form"> Gombrich</span>`;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }
function filterWorldCards() { renderWorldCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('#section-nota .filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

function setWorldFilter(val, btn) {
  currentWorldFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('#section-dunia .filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderWorldCards();
}

function openModal(source, idx) {
  currentDataSource = source;
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = kssmData[idx];
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = source === 'kssm' ? 'Tingkatan ' + item.form : '📚 Gombrich • Sejarah Dunia';
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  document.getElementById('modalDetail').innerHTML = item.detail;
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => { factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i + 1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`; });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  const chapterId = source + '_' + item.id;
  if (!gameState.completedChapters.includes(chapterId)) {
    gameState.completedChapters.push(chapterId);
    const xpGain = source === 'kssm' ? 30 + (item.form * 10) : 50;
    addXP(xpGain); addCoins(10); checkBadges();
    showPopup(`+${xpGain} XP! +10 🪙`);
  }
  saveGameState();
}

function closeModal() { document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active'); stopSpeech(); }
function closeModalOutside(e) { if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal(); }

function nextNote() {
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= kssmData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(currentDataSource, next);
}

function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = kssmData[currentNoteIndex];
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(`${item.title}. ${item.note}`);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY'; utterance.rate = 0.9;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() { speechSynthesis.cancel(); document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active'); }

function switchQuizTab(form, btn) {
  currentQuizForm = form; currentQuizType = 0; currentDataSource = form === 'dunia' ? 'world' : 'kssm';
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach((b, i) => b.classList.toggle('active', i === 0));
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
}

function switchQuizType(type, btn) {
  currentQuizType = type;
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
}

function setDifficulty(diff, btn) {
  currentDifficulty = diff;
  document.querySelectorAll('.diff-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  restartQuiz();
}

function updateQuizTitle() {
  let title = '';
  if (currentQuizForm === 'dunia') title = `${quizTypeIcons[currentQuizType]} Kuiz ${quizTypeNames[currentQuizType]} - Sejarah Dunia`;
  else {
    const formNum = currentQuizForm.replace('t', '');
    title = `${quizTypeIcons[currentQuizType]} Kuiz ${quizTypeNames[currentQuizType]} T${formNum}`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizTitle').textContent = title;
}

function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0; quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1); quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  let allQuestions;
  if (currentQuizForm === 'dunia') { allQuestions = worldQuizData[currentQuizType] || worldQuizData[0]; }
  else { allQuestions = kssmQuizData[currentQuizForm]?.[currentQuizType] || kssmQuizData.t1[0]; }
  let filtered = allQuestions.filter(q => q.diff === currentDifficulty);
  if (filtered.length < 10) { const others = allQuestions.filter(q => q.diff !== currentDifficulty); filtered = [...filtered, ...others].slice(0, 10); }
  currentQuestions = filtered.slice(0, 10);
  renderQuiz();
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const data = currentQuestions;
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / data.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${data.length}`;
  let html = '';
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    const diffBadge = q.diff === 'easy' ? '🟢' : q.diff === 'medium' ? '🟡' : '🔴';
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}"><h3>${diffBadge} ${i + 1}. ${q.q}</h3><div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => { const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : ''; html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65 + j)}. ${opt}</button>`; });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;"> Sebelum</button>`;
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya ➡</button>`;
  else navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) { if (quizSubmitted) return; quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx; renderQuiz(); }
function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { if (currentQuiz < currentQuestions.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } }

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0 && !confirm(`Belum jawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar?`)) return;
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  let score = 0, totalXP = 0;
  currentQuestions.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option').forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) { score++; totalXP += q.xp; }
  });
  const coinsEarned = score * 3;
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/${currentQuestions.length}`;
    const pct = (score / currentQuestions.length) * 100;
    let msg = pct === 100 ? ' Cemerlang!' : pct >= 70 ? '👏 Tahniah!' : pct >= 50 ? '👍 Bagus!' : '💪 Cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
    document.getElementById('resultXP').textContent = `+${totalXP} XP | +${coinsEarned} 🪙`;
    addXP(totalXP); addCoins(coinsEarned);
    const today = new Date().toDateString();
    if (gameState.lastPlayDate !== today) { gameState.streak++; gameState.lastPlayDate = today; }
    gameState.quizHistory.push({ score, total: currentQuestions.length, date: new Date().toISOString(), form: currentQuizForm, type: currentQuizType });
    checkBadges(); saveGameState();
  }, 1000);
}

function startDailyChallenge() {
  showSection('kuiz');
  const forms = ['t1', 't2', 't3', 't4', 't5', 'dunia'];
  currentQuizForm = forms[Math.floor(Math.random() * forms.length)];
  currentQuizType = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5); currentDifficulty = 'medium';
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => { if (b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(currentQuizForm === 'dunia' ? 'dunia' : currentQuizForm.replace('t', ''))) b.classList.add('active'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach((b, i) => b.classList.toggle('active', i === currentQuizType));
  document.querySelectorAll('.diff-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelector('.diff-btn.medium').classList.add('active');
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
  showPopup(' Cabaran Harian Dimula!');
}

function renderGameSection() {
  const missions = [
    { icon: '📚', title: 'Baca 3 Bab KSSM', desc: 'Baca nota dari 3 bab KSSM', reward: '+50 XP, +10 🪙', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('kssm_')).length >= 3, xp: 50, coins: 10 },
    { icon: '🌍', title: 'Teroka Dunia', desc: 'Baca 3 bab Sejarah Dunia', reward: '+80 XP, +15 🪙', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('world_')).length >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 },
    { icon: '', title: 'Jawab 5 Kuiz', desc: 'Tamat 5 kuiz', reward: '+100 XP, +20 ', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.length >= 5, xp: 100, coins: 20 },
    { icon: '', title: 'Skor Sempurna', desc: 'Dapat 10/10 dalam kuiz', reward: '+150 XP, +30 🪙', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.some(q => q.score === 10), xp: 150, coins: 30 },
    { icon: '🔥', title: 'Streak 3 Hari', desc: 'Main 3 hari berturut-turut', reward: '+80 XP, +15 🪙', check: () => gameState.streak >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 },
    { icon: '⭐', title: 'Capai Level 5', desc: 'Naik ke level 5', reward: '+200 XP, +50 ', check: () => gameState.level >= 5, xp: 200, coins: 50 }
  ];
  const missionsHtml = missions.map(m => `<div class="mission-card"><div class="mission-icon">${m.icon}</div><div class="mission-info"><h4>${m.title}</h4><p>${m.desc}</p></div><div class="mission-reward">${m.reward}</div><button onclick="claimMission(this,'${m.title}')" style="background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;border:none;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:12px;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Tuntut</button></div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('missionsList').innerHTML = missionsHtml;
  const badgesHtml = allBadges.map(b => { const earned = gameState.badges.includes(b.id); return `<div class="badge-item ${earned ? 'earned' : 'locked'}"><div class="badge-icon">${b.icon}</div><div class="badge-name">${b.name}</div></div>`; }).join('');
  document.getElementById('badgesGrid').innerHTML = badgesHtml;
  const fakePlayers = [{ name: 'Ahmad', xp: 2500 }, { name: 'Siti', xp: 2200 }, { name: 'Ali', xp: 1800 }, { name: 'Fatimah', xp: 1500 }, { name: 'Anda', xp: gameState.xp, isPlayer: true }, { name: 'Zainab', xp: 800 }, { name: 'Ibrahim', xp: 600 }].sort((a, b) => b.xp - a.xp);
  const lbHtml = fakePlayers.map((p, i) => `<div class="lb-item" style="${p.isPlayer ? 'background:rgba(212,160,23,0.1);border-radius:10px;' : ''}"><div class="lb-rank">#${i + 1}</div><div class="lb-name">${p.isPlayer ? ' ' : ''}${p.name}</div><div class="lb-xp">⚡ ${p.xp} XP</div></div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('leaderboardList').innerHTML = lbHtml;
}

function claimMission(btn, title) {
  const missions = [{ title: 'Baca 3 Bab KSSM', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('kssm_')).length >= 3, xp: 50, coins: 10 }, { title: 'Teroka Dunia', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('world_')).length >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 }, { title: 'Jawab 5 Kuiz', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.length >= 5, xp: 100, coins: 20 }, { title: 'Skor Sempurna', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.some(q => q.score === 10), xp: 150, coins: 30 }, { title: 'Streak 3 Hari', check: () => gameState.streak >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 }, { title: 'Capai Level 5', check: () => gameState.level >= 5, xp: 200, coins: 50 }];
  const mission = missions.find(m => m.title === title);
  if (mission && mission.check()) { addXP(mission.xp); addCoins(mission.coins); showPopup(`+${mission.xp} XP! +${mission.coins} 🪙`); btn.textContent = '✅ Dituntut'; btn.disabled = true; btn.style.opacity = '0.5'; }
  else { showPopup('Misi belum selesai!'); }
}

function renderDashboard() {
  document.getElementById('dashLevel').textContent = gameState.level;
  document.getElementById('dashXP').textContent = gameState.xp;
  document.getElementById('dashCoins').textContent = gameState.coins;
  document.getElementById('dashStreak').textContent = gameState.streak;
  document.getElementById('dashCompleted').textContent = gameState.completedChapters.length;
  document.getElementById('dashBadges').textContent = gameState.badges.length;
  const forms = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
  const formNames = { 1: 'Tingkatan 1', 2: 'Tingkatan 2', 3: 'Tingkatan 3', 4: 'Tingkatan 4', 5: 'Tingkatan 5' };
  let progressHtml = '';
  forms.forEach(f => {
    const chapters = kssmData.filter(n => n.form === f);
    const completed = chapters.filter(c => gameState.completedChapters.includes('kssm_' + c.id)).length;
    const pct = Math.round((completed / chapters.length) * 100);
    progressHtml += `<div style="background:var(--bg-card);border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:15px;margin-bottom:10px;"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;"><strong>${formNames[f]}</strong><span>${completed}/${chapters.length} bab (${pct}%)</span></div><div style="background:rgba(212,160,23,0.2);border-radius:10px;height:10px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="width:${pct}%;height:100%;background:var(--gradient);border-radius:10px;transition:width 0.5s;"></div></div></div>`;
  });
  const worldCompleted = kssmData.filter(c => c.id >= 101 && gameState.completedChapters.includes('world_' + c.id)).length;
  const worldTotal = kssmData.filter(c => c.id >= 101).length;
  const worldPct = worldTotal > 0 ? Math.round((worldCompleted / worldTotal) * 100) : 0;
  progressHtml += `<div style="background:var(--bg-card);border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:15px;margin-bottom:10px;"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;"><strong>🌍 Sejarah Dunia (Gombrich)</strong><span>${worldCompleted}/${worldTotal} bab (${worldPct}%)</span></div><div style="background:rgba(212,160,23,0.2);border-radius:10px;height:10px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="width:${worldPct}%;height:100%;background:var(--gradient);border-radius:10px;transition:width 0.5s;"></div></div></div>`;
  document.getElementById('chapterProgress').innerHTML = progressHtml;
}

let isChatOpen = false;
function toggleChat() { isChatOpen = !isChatOpen; document.getElementById('aiChatWindow').classList.toggle('active', isChatOpen); if (isChatOpen) document.getElementById('chatInput').focus(); }
function handleChatKey(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') sendChatMessage(); }
function sendChatMessage() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
  const message = input.value.trim();
  if (!message) return;
  addChatMessage(message, 'user'); input.value = '';
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'typing-indicator'; typingDiv.id = 'typingIndicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div>';
  chatBody.appendChild(typingDiv); chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
  setTimeout(() => { const typingEl = document.getElementById('typingIndicator'); if (typingEl) typingEl.remove(); addChatMessage(generateAIResponse(message), 'bot'); }, 1500 + Math.random() * 1000);
}
function addChatMessage(text, sender) { const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody'); const msgDiv = document.createElement('div'); msgDiv.className = `chat-message msg-${sender}`; msgDiv.innerHTML = text; chatBody.appendChild(msgDiv); chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight; }

Gombrich highlight bahawa <strong>setiap revolusi teknologi</strong> bawa kemajuan TAPI juga bawa masalah baru - dalam kes Revolusi Industri: child labor, pencemaran, jurang kaya-miskin.

💡 <strong>Cabar Minda Anda (KBAT):</strong>
Revolusi Industri bawa <strong>kemajuan</strong> tapi juga <strong>penjajahan</strong>. Adakah kemajuan teknologi sentiasa bawa kebaikan? Atau ada side effects yang kita masih rasa hingga hari ini?

Cuba reflect! 🧠`;

  if (lowerQuery.includes('merdeka') || lowerQuery.includes('kemerdekaan') || lowerQuery.includes('tunku')) {

Bayangkan 31 Ogos 1957 itu ibarat <strong>'launching day' untuk startup Malaysia</strong> - selepas bertahun 'pitch' dan 'negotiate', finally dapat 'funding' (kemerdekaan)!

## 🎉 AI Tutor Genius - Cross-Historical Reasoning Aktif!

### ✅ Ciri-ciri Baru Mengikut System Prompt:

1. ** Fakta Utama KSSM** - Terangkan teras tajuk mengikut silibus (Tingkatan & Bab)

2. ** Lensa Sejarah Dunia (Pola Serupa)** - Analogi cross-historical yang RELEVAN:
   - Melaka ↔ Venice (kuasa maritim)
   - Tok Janggut ↔ Revolusi Amerika 1776 (cukai tidak adil)
   - NNMB/NNMTB ↔ British di India/Mesir (direct vs indirect rule)
   - Revolusi Industri ↔ Revolusi Digital (transformasi teknologi)
   - Kemerdekaan aman ↔ India 1947 (dekolonisasi peaceful)
   - Rukun Negara ↔ Pancasila Indonesia / Preamble USA (national glue)
   - 13 Mei ↔ Apartheid SA / Rwanda (ketegangan kaum)
   - Ibnu Khaldun ↔ Kejatuhan Rom / Dinasti China (kitaran tamadun)
   - Wawasan 2020 ↔ Restorasi Meiji Jepun (transformasi negara)

3. **💡 Cabar Minda (KBAT)** - Soalan luar kotak untuk ajak pelajar fikir sendiri

### 🎯 Contoh Interaksi:

**Pelajar**: "Kenapa Tok Janggut membangkitkan penentangan di Kelantan?"

**AI Tutor Genius**:
```
🔥 Soalan intense ni!

📌 Fakta Utama KSSM (T3 Bab 7):
Tok Janggut bangkit 1915 M kerana:
• British wajibkan cukai tanah walaupun tanah tidak dikerjakan
• British larang petani tanam padi untuk diri sendiri
• Layanan kuku besi pegawai British

 Lensa Sejarah Dunia (Pola Serupa - Revolusi Amerika 1776):
Kalau kita tengok di Amerika Syarikat semasa dijajah British pada 1700-an, 
rakyat Amerika bangkit berontak atas slogan 
"No Taxation Without Representation"!

Sebab apa? British buat benda yang sama: mengenakan cukai cap 
dan cukai teh ke atas rakyat tempatan tanpa mendengar suara mereka.

💡 Cabar Minda Anda (KBAT):
Jika anda seorang pemimpin pada zaman itu, selain daripada mengangkat 
senjata seperti Tok Janggut atau rakyat Amerika, apakah langkah 
diplomasi yang boleh digunakan?
```

(function() {
  const splash = document.getElementById('splash-screen');
  const video = document.getElementById('splash-video');
  let introShown = false;
  function hideSplash() {
    if (introShown) return;
    introShown = true;
    splash.classList.add('fade-out');
    setTimeout(() => {
      splash.classList.add('hidden');
      try { video.pause(); video.removeAttribute('src'); video.load(); } catch(e) {}
    }, 800);
  }
  window.skipIntro = function() { hideSplash(); };
  video.addEventListener('ended', hideSplash);
  let fallbackTimer = setTimeout(hideSplash, 4000);
  video.addEventListener('playing', () => { clearTimeout(fallbackTimer); });
  video.addEventListener('error', () => { clearTimeout(fallbackTimer); hideSplash(); });
  const playPromise = video.play();
  if (playPromise !== undefined) { playPromise.then(() => {}).catch(() => {}); }
})();

let gameState={xp:0,level:1,coins:0,streak:0,lastPlayDate:null,completedChapters:[],badges:[],quizHistory:[]};
function loadGameState(){const s=localStorage.getItem('myhistoryStateV5');if(s){gameState=JSON.parse(s);const t=new Date().toDateString();if(gameState.lastPlayDate){const d=Math.floor((new Date(t)-new Date(gameState.lastPlayDate))/(864e5));if(d>1)gameState.streak=0;}}updatePlayerStats();}
function saveGameState(){localStorage.setItem('myhistoryStateV5',JSON.stringify(gameState));}
function updatePlayerStats(){['playerLevel','dashLevel'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.level;});['playerXP','dashXP'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.xp;});['playerCoins','dashCoins'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.coins;});['playerStreak','dashStreak'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.streak;});const dc=document.getElementById('dashCompleted');if(dc)dc.textContent=gameState.completedChapters.length;const db=document.getElementById('dashBadges');if(db)db.textContent=gameState.badges.length;}
function addXP(a){gameState.xp+=a;const nl=Math.min(30,Math.floor(gameState.xp/100)+1);if(nl>gameState.level){gameState.level=nl;showPopup(`🎉 Level Up! Level ${nl}!`);checkBadges();}updatePlayerStats();saveGameState();}
function addCoins(a){gameState.coins+=a;updatePlayerStats();saveGameState();}
function showPopup(t){const p=document.createElement('div');p.className='xp-popup';p.textContent=t;document.body.appendChild(p);setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),1500);}

detail:"<p><strong>Penyebaran Hindu-Buddha:</strong> Pedagang India datang ke Alam Melayu sejak awal Masihi untuk berdagang rempah ratus, emas, dan hasil hutan. Mereka membawa agama Hindu dan Buddha bersama budaya India. Proses penyebaran berlaku secara beransur-ansur melalui perdagangan, perkahwinan campur antara pedagang India dengan wanita tempatan, dan dakwah oleh pendeta. Kerajaan-kerajaan awal seperti Funan, Champa, Srivijaya, dan Majapahit memeluk Hindu atau Buddha sebagai agama rasmi. Kuil-kuil dibina sebagai pusat agama dan pentadbiran.</p><p><strong>Pengaruh dalam Seni Bina:</strong> Candi-candi Hindu dan Buddha dibina di seluruh Alam Melayu. Bujang Valley (Kedah) mempunyai lebih 50 candi dari abad ke-5 hingga ke-14 M. Borobudur (Jawa, 825 M) ialah stupa Buddha terbesar dunia dengan 2,672 panel relief. Prambanan (Jawa, 850 M) ialah kompleks kuil Hindu dengan 240 kuil. Angkor Wat (Kemboja, 1113 M) ialah kuil Hindu-Buddha terbesar dunia. Seni ukir batu menunjukkan cerita dari Ramayana dan Mahabharata.</p><p><strong>Pengaruh dalam Kesusasteraan:</strong> Epik Hindu Ramayana (kisah Rama dan Sita) dan Mahabharata (kisah perang Kurukshetra) diterjemah ke bahasa Melayu dan Jawa. Wayang kulit menggunakan cerita-cerita ini untuk persembahan dengan boneka kulit. Hikayat Seri Rama (versi Melayu Ramayana) dan Hikayat Perang Pandawa Jaya (versi Melayu Mahabharata) menjadi popular. Cerita-cerita ini mengajar nilai moral seperti kesetiaan, keberanian, dan keadilan.</p><p><strong>Konsep Devaraja:</strong> Konsep 'devaraja' (raja-dewa) dari Hindu diadaptasi oleh raja-raja Melayu awal. Raja dianggap mempunyai hubungan istimewa dengan dewa-dewa dan kuasanya berasal dari syurga. Upacara pertabalan melibatkan ritual Hindu untuk mengesahkan kuasa raja. Konsep ini memberikan legitimasi ketuhanan kepada pemerintahan raja.</p><p><strong>Kedatangan Islam (Abad ke-13):</strong> Islam datang melalui pedagang Muslim dari Arab, Gujarat, dan Parsi yang berdagang di pelabuhan-pelabuhan Alam Melayu. Proses penyebaran aman melalui perdagangan (pedagang Muslim menunjukkan akhlak baik), perkahwinan (pedagang Muslim kahwin dengan wanita tempatan), dan dakwah (ulama mengajar agama Islam). Kerajaan Samudera Pasai (1267 M) di Sumatera ialah kerajaan Islam pertama di Asia Tenggara. Kesultanan Melaka (1402 M) menjadi pusat penyebaran Islam ke seluruh Alam Melayu.</p><p><strong>Perubahan Sistem Pemerintahan:</strong> Konsep 'devaraja' digantikan dengan 'sultan sebagai khalifah' - wakil Tuhan di bumi. Sultan mempunyai kuasa tetapi juga tanggungjawab untuk menjalankan hukum syarak. Undang-undang berdasarkan Islam diperkenalkan seperti Hukum Kanun Melaka yang menggabungkan hukum syarak dengan adat Melayu. Sistem pentadbiran kekal serupa dengan pembesar empat tetapi dengan nama dan fungsi yang disesuaikan dengan Islam.</p><p><strong>Warisan yang Dikekalkan:</strong> Walaupun agama berubah dari Hindu-Buddha ke Islam, banyak warisan dikekalkan. Sistem pemerintahan beraja diteruskan dengan Sultan menggantikan raja. Warisan ekonomi seperti sistem cukai, perdagangan maritim, dan hubungan dagang diwarisi. Adat istiadat diraja seperti upacara pertabalan dikekalkan dengan penyesuaian Islam. Seni bina tradisional seperti rumah panggung terus digunakan. Bahasa Melayu kekal sebagai lingua franca dengan tambahan kata pinjaman Arab.</p><p><strong>Sintesis Budaya Melayu-Islam:</strong> Gabungan Islam + adat Melayu + warisan Hindu-Buddha menghasilkan budaya unik. Upacara pertabalan Sultan mengandungi unsur adat Melayu tradisional dalam kerangka Islam. Seni bina masjid tradisional menggabungkan unsur Islam (kubah, mihrab) dengan seni bina tempatan (bumbung bertingkat, ukiran kayu). Kesusasteraan Melayu Islam seperti Hikayat Hang Tuah mengandungi nilai Islam dan adat Melayu. Seni pertunjukan seperti wayang kulit dan mak yong diadaptasi dengan cerita Islam.</p>",

Angin monsun menentukan musim pelayaran - pedagang terpaksa tinggal berbulan-bulan menunggu angin berubah, menjadikan Melaka pusat pertukaran barang dan budaya.</p><p><strong>Sistem Pentadbiran:</strong> Sultan sebagai ketua tertinggi. Hubungan ini menguntungkan kedua-dua pihak - Melaka dapat perlindungan, China dapat akses ke perdagangan rempah.</p><p><strong>Undang-undang Laut Melaka:</strong> Kod undang-undang yang mengatur perdagangan dan pelayaran. function showSection(name) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('section-' + name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + name).classList.add('active');
  if (name === 'kuiz') restartQuiz();
  if (name === 'game') renderGameSection();
  if (name === 'dashboard') renderDashboard();
  if (name === 'dunia') renderWorldCards();
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}

function toggleTheme() {
  const body = document.body;
  const btn = document.querySelector('.theme-toggle');
  if (body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') { body.removeAttribute('data-theme'); btn.textContent = '🌙'; }
  else { body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark'); btn.textContent = '☀️'; }
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
  const search = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  kssmData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    let show = true;
    if (currentFilter !== 'all' && item.form !== currentFilter) show = false;
    if (!show) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    const completed = gameState.completedChapters.includes('kssm_' + item.id);
    const xpReward = 30 + (item.form * 10);
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal('kssm', idx);
    card.innerHTML = `${completed ? '<div class="card-completed">✅</div>' : ''}<div class="card-xp">+${xpReward} XP</div><div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div><div class="card-title">${item.title}</div><span class="card-form">Tingkatan ${item.form}</span>`;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function renderWorldCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('worldCardsGrid');
  const search = (document.getElementById('searchWorld')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  const worldDataFiltered = kssmData.filter(n => n.id >= 101);
  worldDataFiltered.forEach((item, idx) => {
    let show = true;
    if (currentWorldFilter !== 'all' && item.category !== currentWorldFilter) show = false;
    if (!show) return;
    if (search && !item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
    const completed = gameState.completedChapters.includes('world_' + item.id);
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'topic-card';
    card.onclick = () => openModal('world', kssmData.indexOf(item));
    card.innerHTML = `${completed ? '<div class="card-completed">✅</div>' : ''}<div class="card-xp">+50 XP</div><div class="card-emoji">${item.emoji}</div><div class="card-title">${item.title}</div><span class="card-form"> Gombrich</span>`;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function filterCards() { renderCards(); }
function filterWorldCards() { renderWorldCards(); }

function setFilter(val, btn) {
  currentFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('#section-nota .filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards();
}

function setWorldFilter(val, btn) {
  currentWorldFilter = val;
  document.querySelectorAll('#section-dunia .filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderWorldCards();
}

function openModal(source, idx) {
  currentDataSource = source;
  currentNoteIndex = idx;
  const item = kssmData[idx];
  document.getElementById('modalEmoji').textContent = item.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = item.title;
  document.getElementById('modalForm').textContent = source === 'kssm' ? 'Tingkatan ' + item.form : '📚 Gombrich • Sejarah Dunia';
  document.getElementById('modalNote').textContent = item.note;
  document.getElementById('modalDetail').innerHTML = item.detail;
  let factsHtml = '';
  item.facts.forEach((f, i) => { factsHtml += `<div class="fact-item"><span class="fact-num">${i + 1}</span><span>${f}</span></div>`; });
  document.getElementById('modalFacts').innerHTML = factsHtml;
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  const chapterId = source + '_' + item.id;
  if (!gameState.completedChapters.includes(chapterId)) {
    gameState.completedChapters.push(chapterId);
    const xpGain = source === 'kssm' ? 30 + (item.form * 10) : 50;
    addXP(xpGain); addCoins(10); checkBadges();
    showPopup(`+${xpGain} XP! +10 🪙`);
  }
  saveGameState();
}

function closeModal() { document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active'); stopSpeech(); }
function closeModalOutside(e) { if (e.target === document.getElementById('modalOverlay')) closeModal(); }

function nextNote() {
  stopSpeech();
  let next = currentNoteIndex + 1;
  if (next >= kssmData.length) next = 0;
  openModal(currentDataSource, next);
}

function playSpeech() {
  stopSpeech();
  const item = kssmData[currentNoteIndex];
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(`${item.title}. ${item.note}`);
  utterance.lang = 'ms-MY'; utterance.rate = 0.9;
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const msVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('ms'));
  if (msVoice) utterance.voice = msVoice;
  utterance.onstart = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.add('active');
  utterance.onend = () => document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active');
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

function stopSpeech() { speechSynthesis.cancel(); document.getElementById('speakingIndicator').classList.remove('active'); }
if (speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) { speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => speechSynthesis.getVoices(); }

function switchQuizTab(form, btn) {
  currentQuizForm = form; currentQuizType = 0; currentDataSource = form === 'dunia' ? 'world' : 'kssm';
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach((b, i) => b.classList.toggle('active', i === 0));
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
}

function switchQuizType(type, btn) {
  currentQuizType = type;
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
}

function setDifficulty(diff, btn) {
  currentDifficulty = diff;
  document.querySelectorAll('.diff-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  restartQuiz();
}

function updateQuizTitle() {
  let title = '';
  if (currentQuizForm === 'dunia') title = `${quizTypeIcons[currentQuizType]} Kuiz ${quizTypeNames[currentQuizType]} - Sejarah Dunia`;
  else {
    const formNum = currentQuizForm.replace('t', '');
    title = `${quizTypeIcons[currentQuizType]} Kuiz ${quizTypeNames[currentQuizType]} T${formNum}`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizTitle').textContent = title;
}

function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0; quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1); quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  let allQuestions;
  if (currentQuizForm === 'dunia') { allQuestions = worldQuizData[currentQuizType] || worldQuizData[0]; }
  else { allQuestions = kssmQuizData[currentQuizForm]?.[currentQuizType] || kssmQuizData.t1[0]; }
  let filtered = allQuestions.filter(q => q.diff === currentDifficulty);
  if (filtered.length < 10) { const others = allQuestions.filter(q => q.diff !== currentDifficulty); filtered = [...filtered, ...others].slice(0, 10); }
  currentQuestions = filtered.slice(0, 10);
  renderQuiz();
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const data = currentQuestions;
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / data.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${data.length}`;
  let html = '';
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    const diffBadge = q.diff === 'easy' ? '🟢' : q.diff === 'medium' ? '🟡' : '🔴';
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}"><h3>${diffBadge} ${i + 1}. ${q.q}</h3><div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => { const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : ''; html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65 + j)}. ${opt}</button>`; });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya ➡</button>`;
  else navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) { if (quizSubmitted) return; quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx; renderQuiz(); }
function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { if (currentQuiz < currentQuestions.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } }

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0 && !confirm(`Belum jawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar?`)) return;
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  let score = 0, totalXP = 0;
  currentQuestions.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option').forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) { score++; totalXP += q.xp; }
  });
  const coinsEarned = score * 3;
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/${currentQuestions.length}`;
    const pct = (score / currentQuestions.length) * 100;
    let msg = pct === 100 ? '🌟 Cemerlang!' : pct >= 70 ? ' Tahniah!' : pct >= 50 ? '👍 Bagus!' : '💪 Cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
    document.getElementById('resultXP').textContent = `+${totalXP} XP | +${coinsEarned} 🪙`;
    addXP(totalXP); addCoins(coinsEarned);
    const today = new Date().toDateString();
    if (gameState.lastPlayDate !== today) { gameState.streak++; gameState.lastPlayDate = today; }
    gameState.quizHistory.push({ score, total: currentQuestions.length, date: new Date().toISOString(), form: currentQuizForm, type: currentQuizType });
    checkBadges(); saveGameState();
  }, 1000);
}

function startDailyChallenge() {
  showSection('kuiz');
  const forms = ['t1', 't2', 't3', 't4', 't5', 'dunia'];
  currentQuizForm = forms[Math.floor(Math.random() * forms.length)];
  currentQuizType = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5); currentDifficulty = 'medium';
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => { if (b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(currentQuizForm === 'dunia' ? 'dunia' : currentQuizForm.replace('t', ''))) b.classList.add('active'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach((b, i) => b.classList.toggle('active', i === currentQuizType));
  document.querySelectorAll('.diff-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelector('.diff-btn.medium').classList.add('active');
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
  showPopup('🎯 Cabaran Harian Dimula!');
}

function renderGameSection() {
  const missions = [
    { icon: '📚', title: 'Baca 3 Bab KSSM', desc: 'Baca nota dari 3 bab KSSM', reward: '+50 XP, +10 🪙', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('kssm_')).length >= 3, xp: 50, coins: 10 },
    { icon: '', title: 'Teroka Dunia', desc: 'Baca 3 bab Sejarah Dunia', reward: '+80 XP, +15 ', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('world_')).length >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 },
    { icon: '📝', title: 'Jawab 5 Kuiz', desc: 'Tamat 5 kuiz', reward: '+100 XP, +20 🪙', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.length >= 5, xp: 100, coins: 20 },
    { icon: '🎯', title: 'Skor Sempurna', desc: 'Dapat 10/10 dalam kuiz', reward: '+150 XP, +30 🪙', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.some(q => q.score === 10), xp: 150, coins: 30 },
    { icon: '🔥', title: 'Streak 3 Hari', desc: 'Main 3 hari berturut-turut', reward: '+80 XP, +15 🪙', check: () => gameState.streak >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 },
    { icon: '⭐', title: 'Capai Level 5', desc: 'Naik ke level 5', reward: '+200 XP, +50 🪙', check: () => gameState.level >= 5, xp: 200, coins: 50 }
  ];
  const missionsHtml = missions.map(m => `<div class="mission-card"><div class="mission-icon">${m.icon}</div><div class="mission-info"><h4>${m.title}</h4><p>${m.desc}</p></div><div class="mission-reward">${m.reward}</div><button onclick="claimMission(this,'${m.title}')" style="background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;border:none;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:12px;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Tuntut</button></div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('missionsList').innerHTML = missionsHtml;
  const badgesHtml = allBadges.map(b => { const earned = gameState.badges.includes(b.id); return `<div class="badge-item ${earned ? 'earned' : 'locked'}"><div class="badge-icon">${b.icon}</div><div class="badge-name">${b.name}</div></div>`; }).join('');
  document.getElementById('badgesGrid').innerHTML = badgesHtml;
  const fakePlayers = [{ name: 'Ahmad', xp: 2500 }, { name: 'Siti', xp: 2200 }, { name: 'Ali', xp: 1800 }, { name: 'Fatimah', xp: 1500 }, { name: 'Anda', xp: gameState.xp, isPlayer: true }, { name: 'Zainab', xp: 800 }, { name: 'Ibrahim', xp: 600 }].sort((a, b) => b.xp - a.xp);
  const lbHtml = fakePlayers.map((p, i) => `<div class="lb-item" style="${p.isPlayer ? 'background:rgba(212,160,23,0.1);border-radius:10px;' : ''}"><div class="lb-rank">#${i + 1}</div><div class="lb-name">${p.isPlayer ? ' ' : ''}${p.name}</div><div class="lb-xp">⚡ ${p.xp} XP</div></div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('leaderboardList').innerHTML = lbHtml;
}

function claimMission(btn, title) {
  const missions = [{ title: 'Baca 3 Bab KSSM', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('kssm_')).length >= 3, xp: 50, coins: 10 }, { title: 'Teroka Dunia', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('world_')).length >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 }, { title: 'Jawab 5 Kuiz', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.length >= 5, xp: 100, coins: 20 }, { title: 'Skor Sempurna', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.some(q => q.score === 10), xp: 150, coins: 30 }, { title: 'Streak 3 Hari', check: () => gameState.streak >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 }, { title: 'Capai Level 5', check: () => gameState.level >= 5, xp: 200, coins: 50 }];
  const mission = missions.find(m => m.title === title);
  if (mission && mission.check()) { addXP(mission.xp); addCoins(mission.coins); showPopup(`+${mission.xp} XP! +${mission.coins} 🪙`); btn.textContent = '✅ Dituntut'; btn.disabled = true; btn.style.opacity = '0.5'; }
  else { showPopup('Misi belum selesai!'); }
}

function renderDashboard() {
  document.getElementById('dashLevel').textContent = gameState.level;
  document.getElementById('dashXP').textContent = gameState.xp;
  document.getElementById('dashCoins').textContent = gameState.coins;
  document.getElementById('dashStreak').textContent = gameState.streak;
  document.getElementById('dashCompleted').textContent = gameState.completedChapters.length;
  document.getElementById('dashBadges').textContent = gameState.badges.length;
  const forms = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
  const formNames = { 1: 'Tingkatan 1', 2: 'Tingkatan 2', 3: 'Tingkatan 3', 4: 'Tingkatan 4', 5: 'Tingkatan 5' };
  let progressHtml = '';
  forms.forEach(f => {
    const chapters = kssmData.filter(n => n.form === f);
    const completed = chapters.filter(c => gameState.completedChapters.includes('kssm_' + c.id)).length;
    const pct = Math.round((completed / chapters.length) * 100);
    progressHtml += `<div style="background:var(--bg-card);border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:15px;margin-bottom:10px;"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;"><strong>${formNames[f]}</strong><span>${completed}/${chapters.length} bab (${pct}%)</span></div><div style="background:rgba(212,160,23,0.2);border-radius:10px;height:10px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="width:${pct}%;height:100%;background:var(--gradient);border-radius:10px;transition:width 0.5s;"></div></div></div>`;
  });
  const worldCompleted = kssmData.filter(c => c.id >= 101 && gameState.completedChapters.includes('world_' + c.id)).length;
  const worldTotal = kssmData.filter(c => c.id >= 101).length;
  const worldPct = worldTotal > 0 ? Math.round((worldCompleted / worldTotal) * 100) : 0;
  progressHtml += `<div style="background:var(--bg-card);border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:15px;margin-bottom:10px;"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;"><strong> Sejarah Dunia (Gombrich)</strong><span>${worldCompleted}/${worldTotal} bab (${worldPct}%)</span></div><div style="background:rgba(212,160,23,0.2);border-radius:10px;height:10px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="width:${worldPct}%;height:100%;background:var(--gradient);border-radius:10px;transition:width 0.5s;"></div></div></div>`;
  document.getElementById('chapterProgress').innerHTML = progressHtml;
}

let isChatOpen = false;
function toggleChat() { isChatOpen = !isChatOpen; document.getElementById('aiChatWindow').classList.toggle('active', isChatOpen); if (isChatOpen) document.getElementById('chatInput').focus(); }
function handleChatKey(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') sendChatMessage(); }
function sendChatMessage() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
  const message = input.value.trim();
  if (!message) return;
  addChatMessage(message, 'user'); input.value = '';
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'typing-indicator'; typingDiv.id = 'typingIndicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div>';
  chatBody.appendChild(typingDiv); chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
  setTimeout(() => { const typingEl = document.getElementById('typingIndicator'); if (typingEl) typingEl.remove(); addChatMessage(generateAIResponse(message), 'bot'); }, 1500 + Math.random() * 1000);
}
function addChatMessage(text, sender) { const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody'); const msgDiv = document.createElement('div'); msgDiv.className = `chat-message msg-${sender}`; msgDiv.innerHTML = text; chatBody.appendChild(msgDiv); chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight; }

// ===== AI TUTOR GENIUS - CROSS-HISTORICAL REASONING ENGINE =====
function generateAIResponse(query) {
  const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase().trim();
  
  // Greeting detection
  if (lowerQuery.includes('hai') || lowerQuery.includes('hello') || lowerQuery.includes('assalamualaikum') || lowerQuery.includes('hi ') || lowerQuery === 'hi') {
    return `Waalaikumussalam! 👋

Saya <strong>AI Tutor Genius MyHistory</strong> - pakar <strong>Cross-Historical Reasoning</strong>!

Saya bukan AI biasa. Saya gabungkan:
📌 <strong>Fakta KSSM</strong> yang tepat
🌍 <strong>Pola Sejarah Dunia</strong> yang relevan
💡 <strong>Soalan KBAT</strong> yang cabar minda

Contoh soalan power:
• <em>"Kenapa Melaka boleh jadi pusat perdagangan hebat?"</em>
• <em>"Macam mana Jepun boleh kalahkan British?"</em>
• <em>"Apa beza sistem Residen dengan Penasihat?"</em>
• <em>"Mengapa Tok Janggut bangkit?"</em>
• <em>"Kenapa 13 Mei 1969 boleh berlaku?"</em>

Saya sedia cabar minda anda! 🧠✨`;
  }
  
  // Thanks detection
  if (lowerQuery.includes('terima kasih') || lowerQuery.includes('thanks') || lowerQuery.includes('thank you')) {
    return `Sama-sama! 😊

Ingat: <strong>Sejarah bukan sekadar hafal</strong> - ia tentang faham <strong>kenapa</strong> dan <strong>bagaimana</strong> sesuatu berlaku.

Terus belajar dengan MyHistory! 💪`;
  }

  // ===== TOPIC DETECTION WITH CROSS-HISTORICAL ANALOGIES =====
  
  // MELAKA

Bayangkan Melaka zaman 1500-an itu ibarat <strong>'Silicon Valley' atau Lapangan Terbang Changi zaman kuno</strong>! Semua pedagang dunia wajib 'transit' dekat sini.

📌 <strong>Fakta Utama KSSM (Tingkatan 2 Bab 5):</strong>

Sebab apa? Kerana Venice berdiri betul-betul di <strong>persimpangan laluan dagang</strong> Mediterranean, sama macam Melaka di persimpangan laluan dagang Asia. Siapa pegang 'chokepoint' perdagangan, dia pegang <strong>'kunci kekayaan dunia'</strong>!

🌍 <strong>Lensa Sejarah Dunia (Pola Serupa - Revolusi Digital 2000-an):</strong>
Kalau kita compare dengan zaman sekarang—<strong>Revolusi Digital</strong> (internet, smartphone) juga ubah dunia dalam masa 20 tahun sahaja! Sama macam Revolusi Industri ubah dunia dari 'farmers' kepada 'factory workers', Revolusi Digital ubah kita dari 'factory workers' kepada 'knowledge workers'!

Gombrich highlight bahawa <strong>setiap revolusi teknologi</strong> bawa kemajuan TAPI juga bawa masalah baru—dalam kes Revolusi Industri: child labor, pencemaran, jurang kaya-miskin.

💡 <strong>Cabar Minda Anda (KBAT):</strong>
Revolusi Industri bawa <strong>kemajuan</strong> tapi juga <strong>penjajahan</strong>. Adakah kemajuan teknologi sentiasa bawa kebaikan? Atau ada side effects yang kita masih rasa hingga hari ini?

Cuba reflect! 🧠`;

  // MERDEKA
  if (lowerQuery.includes('merdeka') || lowerQuery.includes('kemerdekaan') || lowerQuery.includes('tunku')) {
    return `🔥 <strong>Soalan yang buat kita proud ni!</strong>

Bayangkan 31 Ogos 1957 itu ibarat <strong>'launching day' untuk startup Malaysia</strong>—selepas bertahun 'pitch' dan 'negotiate', finally dapat 'funding' (kemerdekaan)!

📌 <strong>Fakta Utama KSSM (Tingkatan 4 Bab 7 & 10):</strong>
• <strong>Pilihan Raya 1955</strong> - Parti Perikatan menang 51/52 kerusi (mandat rakyat!)

### USER
<system_prompt>
  <role>
    Anda ialah Tutor AI Sejarah KSSM (Tingkatan 1 - 5) yang cerdik, berfikiran analitis (KBAT), dan fleksibel.
  </role>

  <instructions>
    1. FOKUS 100% PADA TAJUK KSSM: Jawab soalan berdasarkan konteks Sejarah KSSM/Malaysia yang ditanya oleh pelajar sahaja. JANGAN sesekali memasukkan contoh sejarah luar negara yang tidak berkaitan.
    2. CARA BERFIKIR DI LUAR KOTAK (OUT OF THE BOX):
       - Hubungkan fakta sejarah dengan **Impak Kehidupan Sehari-hari / Dunia Moden** (cth: teknologi, ekonomi moden, pengajaran kepimpinan).
       - Gunakan **Analogi Mudah & Logik Sebab-Akibat** (Sebab apa watak buat keputusan begitu? Apa kesan dominonya?).
    3. PENDAPAT & KBAT: Duga pelajar dengan 1 soalan KBAT/Sokratik yang relevan untuk buka minda mereka.
    4. VARIASI JAWAPAN: Setiap kali menjawab soalan baharu atau soalan susulan, gunakan struktur dan gaya bahasa yang berbeza. DILARANG mengulang skrip/template yang sama.
  </instructions>

  <formatting>
    - Gunakan perenggan pendek dan perkataan tebal (bold) pada kata kunci.
    - Nada bahasa: Mesra, bersemangat, dan analitis (seperti abang/kakak tutor yang bijak).
  </formatting>
</system_prompt>

  function hideSplash() {
    if (introShown) return;
    introShown = true;
    splash.classList.add('fade-out');
    setTimeout(() => {
      splash.classList.add('hidden');
      try { video.pause(); video.removeAttribute('src'); video.load(); } catch(e) {}
    }, 800);
  }
  window.skipIntro = function() { hideSplash(); };
  video.addEventListener('ended', hideSplash);
  let fallbackTimer = setTimeout(hideSplash, 4000);
  video.addEventListener('playing', () => { clearTimeout(fallbackTimer); });
  video.addEventListener('error', () => { clearTimeout(fallbackTimer); hideSplash(); });
  const playPromise = video.play();
  if (playPromise !== undefined) { playPromise.then(() => {}).catch(() => {}); }
})();

let gameState={xp:0,level:1,coins:0,streak:0,lastPlayDate:null,completedChapters:[],badges:[],quizHistory:[]};
function loadGameState(){const s=localStorage.getItem('myhistoryStateV5');if(s){gameState=JSON.parse(s);const t=new Date().toDateString();if(gameState.lastPlayDate){const d=Math.floor((new Date(t)-new Date(gameState.lastPlayDate))/(864e5));if(d>1)gameState.streak=0;}}updatePlayerStats();}
function saveGameState(){localStorage.setItem('myhistoryStateV5',JSON.stringify(gameState));}
function updatePlayerStats(){['playerLevel','dashLevel'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.level;});['playerXP','dashXP'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.xp;});['playerCoins','dashCoins'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.coins;});['playerStreak','dashStreak'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e)e.textContent=gameState.streak;});const dc=document.getElementById('dashCompleted');if(dc)dc.textContent=gameState.completedChapters.length;const db=document.getElementById('dashBadges');if(db)db.textContent=gameState.badges.length;}
function addXP(a){gameState.xp+=a;const nl=Math.min(30,Math.floor(gameState.xp/100)+1);if(nl>gameState.level){gameState.level=nl;showPopup(`🎉 Level Up! Level ${nl}!`);checkBadges();}updatePlayerStats();saveGameState();}
function addCoins(a){gameState.coins+=a;updatePlayerStats();saveGameState();}
function showPopup(t){const p=document.createElement('div');p.className='xp-popup';p.textContent=t;document.body.appendChild(p);setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),1500);}
