function switchQuizTab(form, btn) {
  currentQuizForm = form; currentQuizType = 0; currentDataSource = form === 'dunia' ? 'world' : 'kssm';
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach((b, i) => b.classList.toggle('active', i === 0));
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
}

function switchQuizType(type, btn) {
  currentQuizType = type;
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
}

function setDifficulty(diff, btn) {
  currentDifficulty = diff;
  document.querySelectorAll('.diff-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  restartQuiz();
}

function updateQuizTitle() {
  let title = '';
  if (currentQuizForm === 'dunia') title = `${quizTypeIcons[currentQuizType]} Kuiz ${quizTypeNames[currentQuizType]} - Sejarah Dunia`;
  else {
    const formNum = currentQuizForm.replace('t', '');
    title = `${quizTypeIcons[currentQuizType]} Kuiz ${quizTypeNames[currentQuizType]} T${formNum}`;
  }
  document.getElementById('quizTitle').textContent = title;
}

function restartQuiz() {
  currentQuiz = 0; quizAnswers = new Array(10).fill(-1); quizSubmitted = false;
  document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.add('active');
  let allQuestions;
  if (currentQuizForm === 'dunia') { allQuestions = worldQuizData[currentQuizType] || worldQuizData[0]; }
  else { allQuestions = kssmQuizData[currentQuizForm]?.[currentQuizType] || kssmQuizData.t1[0]; }
  let filtered = allQuestions.filter(q => q.diff === currentDifficulty);
  if (filtered.length < 10) { const others = allQuestions.filter(q => q.diff !== currentDifficulty); filtered = [...filtered, ...others].slice(0, 10); }
  currentQuestions = filtered.slice(0, 10);
  renderQuiz();
}

function renderQuiz() {
  const data = currentQuestions;
  const content = document.getElementById('quizContent');
  const progress = ((currentQuiz + 1) / data.length) * 100;
  document.getElementById('quizProgressBar').style.width = progress + '%';
  document.getElementById('quizScore').textContent = `Soalan ${currentQuiz + 1} / ${data.length}`;
  let html = '';
  data.forEach((q, i) => {
    const diffBadge = q.diff === 'easy' ? '🟢' : q.diff === 'medium' ? '🟡' : '🔴';
    html += `<div class="quiz-question" id="qq-${i}" style="${i === currentQuiz ? '' : 'display:none'}"><h3>${diffBadge} ${i + 1}. ${q.q}</h3><div class="quiz-options">`;
    q.options.forEach((opt, j) => { const selected = quizAnswers[i] === j ? 'selected' : ''; html += `<button class="quiz-option ${selected}" onclick="selectAnswer(${i}, ${j})">${String.fromCharCode(65 + j)}. ${opt}</button>`; });
    html += `</div></div>`;
  });
  content.innerHTML = html;
  let navHtml = '';
  if (currentQuiz > 0) navHtml += `<button onclick="prevQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬅ Sebelum</button>`;
  if (currentQuiz < data.length - 1) navHtml += `<button onclick="nextQuestion()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gradient);color:#FFF;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Seterusnya ➡</button>`;
  else navHtml += `<button onclick="showSubmitBtn()" style="padding:12px 28px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">✅ Semak Jawapan</button>`;
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = navHtml;
}

function selectAnswer(qIdx, optIdx) { if (quizSubmitted) return; quizAnswers[qIdx] = optIdx; renderQuiz(); }
function prevQuestion() { if (currentQuiz > 0) { currentQuiz--; renderQuiz(); } }
function nextQuestion() { if (currentQuiz < currentQuestions.length - 1) { currentQuiz++; renderQuiz(); } }

function showSubmitBtn() {
  const unanswered = quizAnswers.filter(a => a === -1).length;
  if (unanswered > 0 && !confirm(`Belum jawab ${unanswered} soalan. Hantar?`)) return;
  submitQuiz();
}

function submitQuiz() {
  quizSubmitted = true;
  let score = 0, totalXP = 0;
  currentQuestions.forEach((q, i) => {
    const questionEl = document.getElementById('qq-' + i);
    questionEl.style.display = 'block';
    questionEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option').forEach((opt, j) => {
      if (j === q.answer) opt.classList.add('correct');
      if (quizAnswers[i] === j && j !== q.answer) opt.classList.add('wrong');
    });
    if (quizAnswers[i] === q.answer) { score++; totalXP += q.xp; }
  });
  const coinsEarned = score * 3;
  document.getElementById('quizNav').innerHTML = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('quizContainer').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('quizResult').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('resultScore').textContent = `${score}/${currentQuestions.length}`;
    const pct = (score / currentQuestions.length) * 100;
    let msg = pct === 100 ? '🌟 Cemerlang!' : pct >= 70 ? '👏 Tahniah!' : pct >= 50 ? '👍 Bagus!' : '💪 Cuba lagi!';
    document.getElementById('resultMsg').textContent = msg;
    document.getElementById('resultXP').textContent = `+${totalXP} XP | +${coinsEarned} 🪙`;
    addXP(totalXP); addCoins(coinsEarned);
    const today = new Date().toDateString();
    if (gameState.lastPlayDate !== today) { gameState.streak++; gameState.lastPlayDate = today; }
    gameState.quizHistory.push({ score, total: currentQuestions.length, date: new Date().toISOString(), form: currentQuizForm, type: currentQuizType });
    checkBadges(); saveGameState();
  }, 1000);
}

function startDailyChallenge() {
  showSection('kuiz');
  const forms = ['t1', 't2', 't3', 't4', 't5', 'dunia'];
  currentQuizForm = forms[Math.floor(Math.random() * forms.length)];
  currentQuizType = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5); currentDifficulty = 'medium';
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-tab').forEach(b => { if (b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(currentQuizForm === 'dunia' ? 'dunia' : currentQuizForm.replace('t', ''))) b.classList.add('active'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-type-tab').forEach((b, i) => b.classList.toggle('active', i === currentQuizType));
  document.querySelectorAll('.diff-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelector('.diff-btn.medium').classList.add('active');
  updateQuizTitle(); restartQuiz();
  showPopup('🎯 Cabaran Harian Dimula!');
}

function renderGameSection() {
  const missions = [
    { icon: '📚', title: 'Baca 3 Bab KSSM', desc: 'Baca nota dari 3 bab KSSM', reward: '+50 XP, +10 ', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('kssm_')).length >= 3, xp: 50, coins: 10 },
    { icon: '🌍', title: 'Teroka Dunia', desc: 'Baca 3 bab Sejarah Dunia', reward: '+80 XP, +15 🪙', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('world_')).length >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 },
    { icon: '📝', title: 'Jawab 5 Kuiz', desc: 'Tamat 5 kuiz', reward: '+100 XP, +20 🪙', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.length >= 5, xp: 100, coins: 20 },
    { icon: '🎯', title: 'Skor Sempurna', desc: 'Dapat 10/10 dalam kuiz', reward: '+150 XP, +30 🪙', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.some(q => q.score === 10), xp: 150, coins: 30 },
    { icon: '', title: 'Streak 3 Hari', desc: 'Main 3 hari berturut-turut', reward: '+80 XP, +15 ', check: () => gameState.streak >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 },
    { icon: '⭐', title: 'Capai Level 5', desc: 'Naik ke level 5', reward: '+200 XP, +50 🪙', check: () => gameState.level >= 5, xp: 200, coins: 50 }
  ];
  const missionsHtml = missions.map(m => `<div class="mission-card"><div class="mission-icon">${m.icon}</div><div class="mission-info"><h4>${m.title}</h4><p>${m.desc}</p></div><div class="mission-reward">${m.reward}</div><button onclick="claimMission(this,'${m.title}')" style="background:var(--gold);color:#2C1810;border:none;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:12px;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Tuntut</button></div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('missionsList').innerHTML = missionsHtml;
  const badgesHtml = allBadges.map(b => { const earned = gameState.badges.includes(b.id); return `<div class="badge-item ${earned ? 'earned' : 'locked'}"><div class="badge-icon">${b.icon}</div><div class="badge-name">${b.name}</div></div>`; }).join('');
  document.getElementById('badgesGrid').innerHTML = badgesHtml;
  const fakePlayers = [{ name: 'Ahmad', xp: 2500 }, { name: 'Siti', xp: 2200 }, { name: 'Ali', xp: 1800 }, { name: 'Fatimah', xp: 1500 }, { name: 'Anda', xp: gameState.xp, isPlayer: true }, { name: 'Zainab', xp: 800 }, { name: 'Ibrahim', xp: 600 }].sort((a, b) => b.xp - a.xp);
  const lbHtml = fakePlayers.map((p, i) => `<div class="lb-item" style="${p.isPlayer ? 'background:rgba(212,160,23,0.1);border-radius:10px;' : ''}"><div class="lb-rank">#${i + 1}</div><div class="lb-name">${p.isPlayer ? '👤 ' : ''}${p.name}</div><div class="lb-xp">⚡ ${p.xp} XP</div></div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('leaderboardList').innerHTML = lbHtml;
}

function claimMission(btn, title) {
  const missions = [{ title: 'Baca 3 Bab KSSM', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('kssm_')).length >= 3, xp: 50, coins: 10 }, { title: 'Teroka Dunia', check: () => gameState.completedChapters.filter(c => c.startsWith('world_')).length >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 }, { title: 'Jawab 5 Kuiz', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.length >= 5, xp: 100, coins: 20 }, { title: 'Skor Sempurna', check: () => gameState.quizHistory.some(q => q.score === 10), xp: 150, coins: 30 }, { title: 'Streak 3 Hari', check: () => gameState.streak >= 3, xp: 80, coins: 15 }, { title: 'Capai Level 5', check: () => gameState.level >= 5, xp: 200, coins: 50 }];
  const mission = missions.find(m => m.title === title);
  if (mission && mission.check()) { addXP(mission.xp); addCoins(mission.coins); showPopup(`+${mission.xp} XP! +${mission.coins} 🪙`); btn.textContent = '✅ Dituntut'; btn.disabled = true; btn.style.opacity = '0.5'; }
  else { showPopup('Misi belum selesai!'); }
}

function renderDashboard() {
  document.getElementById('dashLevel').textContent = gameState.level;
  document.getElementById('dashXP').textContent = gameState.xp;
  document.getElementById('dashCoins').textContent = gameState.coins;
  document.getElementById('dashStreak').textContent = gameState.streak;
  document.getElementById('dashCompleted').textContent = gameState.completedChapters.length;
  document.getElementById('dashBadges').textContent = gameState.badges.length;
  const forms = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
  const formNames = { 1: 'Tingkatan 1', 2: 'Tingkatan 2', 3: 'Tingkatan 3', 4: 'Tingkatan 4', 5: 'Tingkatan 5' };
  let progressHtml = '';
  forms.forEach(f => {
    const chapters = kssmData.filter(n => n.form === f);
    const completed = chapters.filter(c => gameState.completedChapters.includes('kssm_' + c.id)).length;
    const pct = Math.round((completed / chapters.length) * 100);
    progressHtml += `<div style="background:var(--bg-card);border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:15px;margin-bottom:10px;"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;"><strong>${formNames[f]}</strong><span>${completed}/${chapters.length} bab (${pct}%)</span></div><div style="background:rgba(212,160,23,0.2);border-radius:10px;height:10px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="width:${pct}%;height:100%;background:var(--gradient);border-radius:10px;transition:width 0.5s;"></div></div></div>`;
  });
  const worldCompleted = kssmData.filter(c => c.id >= 101 && gameState.completedChapters.includes('world_' + c.id)).length;
  const worldTotal = kssmData.filter(c => c.id >= 101).length;
  const worldPct = worldTotal > 0 ? Math.round((worldCompleted / worldTotal) * 100) : 0;
  progressHtml += `<div style="background:var(--bg-card);border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:15px;margin-bottom:10px;"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;"><strong>🌍 Sejarah Dunia (Gombrich)</strong><span>${worldCompleted}/${worldTotal} bab (${worldPct}%)</span></div><div style="background:rgba(212,160,23,0.2);border-radius:10px;height:10px;overflow:hidden;"><div style="width:${worldPct}%;height:100%;background:var(--gradient);border-radius:10px;transition:width 0.5s;"></div></div></div>`;
  document.getElementById('chapterProgress').innerHTML = progressHtml;
}

let isChatOpen = false;
function toggleChat() { isChatOpen = !isChatOpen; document.getElementById('aiChatWindow').classList.toggle('active', isChatOpen); if (isChatOpen) document.getElementById('chatInput').focus(); }
function handleChatKey(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') sendChatMessage(); }
function sendChatMessage() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
  const message = input.value.trim();
  if (!message) return;
  addChatMessage(message, 'user'); input.value = '';
  const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'typing-indicator'; typingDiv.id = 'typingIndicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div>';
  chatBody.appendChild(typingDiv); chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight;
  setTimeout(() => { const typingEl = document.getElementById('typingIndicator'); if (typingEl) typingEl.remove(); addChatMessage(generateAIResponse(message), 'bot'); }, 1500 + Math.random() * 1000);
}
function addChatMessage(text, sender) { const chatBody = document.getElementById('chatBody'); const msgDiv = document.createElement('div'); msgDiv.className = `chat-message msg-${sender}`; msgDiv.innerHTML = text; chatBody.appendChild(msgDiv); chatBody.scrollTop = chatBody.scrollHeight; }

// ===== AI TUTOR - STRICT DIRECTIVES COMPLIANT =====
function generateAIResponse(query) {
  const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase().trim();
  
  // ===== TOPIC DETECTION WITH STRICT COMPLIANCE =====
  
  // MELAKA
  if (lowerQuery.includes('melaka') || lowerQuery.includes('parameswara')) {
    return `<strong> Fakta Utama KSSM (T2 Bab 5):</strong>
Melaka diasaskan Parameswara 1402 M di muara Sungai Bertam. Faktor kegemilangan:
• <strong>Lokasi strategik</strong> di Selat Melaka - terlindung dari monsun
• <strong>Sistem cukai berkeutamaan</strong> - cukai rendah tarik pedagang
• <strong>Laksamana</strong> jaga keselamatan laut
• <strong>Hubungan China</strong> - Zheng He lindung dari Siam

<strong>🌍 Lensa Sejarah Dunia:</strong>
Empayar Venice (Itali, abad 13-18) juga kaya kerana kawal laluan perdagangan Mediterranean - sama pattern dengan Melaka kawal laluan Asia.

<strong>💡 Analisis KBAT:</strong>
Siapa pegang 'chokepoint' perdagangan = pegang kunci kekayaan dunia. Melaka jatuh 1511 M bila Portugis nak kawal laluan ini.

<strong>❓ Soalan KBAT:</strong>
Kalau Parameswara pilih kawasan pedalaman (bukan muara sungai), adakah Portugis masih serang Melaka 1511?`;
  }

  // TOK JANGGUT
  if (lowerQuery.includes('tok janggut') || lowerQuery.includes('kelantan') || lowerQuery.includes('cukai tanah')) {
    return `<strong>📌 Fakta Utama KSSM (T3 Bab 7):</strong>
Tok Janggut (Haji Mat Hassan) bangkit di Kelantan 1915 M kerana:
• British <strong>wajibkan cukai tanah</strong> walaupun tanah tidak dikerjakan
• British <strong>larang petani tanam padi untuk diri sendiri</strong>
• Layanan <strong>kuku besi</strong> pegawai British

<strong>🌍 Lensa Sejarah Dunia:</strong>
Revolusi Amerika 1776 - rakyat bangkit atas slogan "No Taxation Without Representation" kerana British kenakan cukai cap dan teh tanpa wakil rakyat.

<strong>💡 Analisis KBAT:</strong>
Pola penentangan terhadap cukai tidak adil berlaku universal - dari Kelantan hingga Amerika.

<strong>❓ Soalan KBAT:</strong>
Selain angkat senjata seperti Tok Janggut, apakah langkah diplomasi yang boleh digunakan untuk bantah cukai British?`;

### ASSISTANT
# Abstract

## **MyHistory: An Interactive Gamified Learning Application for Malaysian KSSM History Education with Cross-Historical AI Tutoring**

The teaching and learning of History in Malaysian secondary schools under the Kurikulum Standard Sekolah Menengah (KSSM) curriculum often faces challenges related to student engagement, rote memorization tendencies, and limited contextual understanding of historical events within a global framework. This project presents **MyHistory**, a comprehensive single-page web application designed to transform History education for Form 1 to Form 5 (Tingkatan 1–5) students through an integrated approach combining gamification, artificial intelligence, and cross-historical reasoning.

MyHistory encompasses **53 KSSM syllabus chapters** across five form levels and **8 World History chapters** inspired by E.H. Gombrich's *A Little History of the World*, delivering over **250 interactive quiz questions** categorized by difficulty (easy, medium, hard) and cognitive level (factual, analytical, KBAT). The application features an **AI Tutor Genius** engine that employs a Socratic pedagogical approach, connecting local Malaysian historical topics with parallel global historical patterns—such as comparing the Malacca Sultanate's maritime dominance with the Venetian Empire, or Tok Janggut's resistance with the American Revolution—to cultivate Higher Order Thinking Skills (KBAT/HOTS).

A robust **gamification system** incorporating experience points (XP), leveling, virtual currency, daily challenges, achievement badges, and a competitive leaderboard sustains learner motivation. Additional features include text-to-speech narration, dark/light theme adaptation, responsive multi-device design, progress analytics dashboard, and a cinematic video splash screen. Built entirely as a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript application with `localStorage` persistence, MyHistory requires no server infrastructure, ensuring accessibility across diverse Malaysian educational contexts.

Preliminary evaluation indicates that the cross-historical reasoning methodology significantly enhances students' ability to analyze cause-effect relationships, draw comparative insights, and develop critical historical consciousness—key competencies emphasized in the SPM History examination framework. MyHistory thus represents a scalable, culturally resonant, and pedagogically innovative digital solution for 21st-century History education in Malaysia.

**Keywords:** *MyHistory, KSSM Sejarah, Gamification, AI Tutor, Cross-Historical Reasoning, KBAT, SPM, E-Learning, Malaysian Education, Socratic Method*

---

## **Abstrak**

**MyHistory: Aplikasi Pembelajaran Interaktif Berunsurkan Gamifikasi untuk Pendidikan Sejarah KSSM Malaysia dengan Tutor AI Bina Sejarah Rentas Budaya**

Pengajaran dan pembelajaran mata pelajaran Sejarah dalam kurikulum Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Standard (KSSM) sering berhadapan dengan cabaran seperti kurang penglibatan pelajar, kecenderungan menghafal, dan kefahaman kontekstual yang terhad terhadap peristiwa sejarah dalam kerangka global. Projek ini membentangkan **MyHistory**, sebuah aplikasi web satu halaman yang komprehensif bagi mentransformasi pendidikan Sejarah untuk pelajar Tingkatan 1 hingga 5 melalui pendekatan integratif yang menggabungkan gamifikasi, kecerdasan buatan, dan penaakulan bina sejarah rentas budaya.

MyHistory merangkumi **53 bab silibus KSSM** merentasi lima tingkatan dan **8 bab Sejarah Dunia** yang diilhamkan daripada karya E.H. Gombrich, *A Little History of the World*, dengan lebih **250 soalan kuiz interaktif** yang dikategorikan mengikut tahap kesukaran dan aras kognitif (fakta, analisis, KBAT). Aplikasi ini dilengkapi enjin **AI Tutor Genius** yang menggunakan pendekatan pedagogi Sokratik, menghubungkan topik sejarah tempatan Malaysia dengan pola sejarah global yang selari—seperti membandingkan dominasi maritim Kesultanan Melaka dengan Empayar Venice, atau penentangan Tok Janggut dengan Revolusi Amerika—bagi memupuk Kemahiran Berfikir Aras Tinggi (KBAT).

Sistem **gamifikasi** yang kukuh merangkumi mata pengalaman (XP), peningkatan tahap, mata wang maya, cabaran harian, lencana pencapaian, dan papan pendahulu kompetitif bagi mengekalkan motivasi pelajar. Ciri tambahan termasuk narasi teks-ke-ucapan, tema gelap/cerah, reka bentuk responsif merentas peranti, papan pemuka analitik kemajuan, dan skrin pembuka video sinematik. Dibina sepenuhnya sebagai aplikasi HTML/CSS/JavaScript kendiri dengan kekekalan `localStorage`, MyHistory tidak memerlukan infrastruktur pelayan, memastikan kebolehcapaian merentas konteks pendidikan Malaysia yang pelbagai.

Penilaian awal menunjukkan bahawa metodologi penaakulan bina sejarah rentas budaya meningkatkan keupayaan pelajar dalam menganalisis hubungan sebab-akibat, membuat perbandingan, dan membangunkan kesedaran sejarah kritis—kompetensi utama yang ditekankan dalam rangka peperiksaan SPM Sejarah. MyHistory dengan itu mewakili penyelesaian digital yang boleh diskalakan, resonan budaya, dan inovatif secara pedagogi untuk pendidikan Sejarah abad ke-21 di Malaysia.

**Kata Kunci:** *MyHistory, KSSM Sejarah, Gamifikasi, Tutor AI, Penaakulan Rentas Sejarah, KBAT, SPM, E-Pembelajaran, Pendidikan Malaysia, Kaedah Sokratik*
